lengthNote: official_length is the wiki's length category. These pages do not publish a single clock time.

Cook's Assistant.start: Talk to the Cook in the kitchen of Lumbridge Castle.
Cook's Assistant.description:
The Lumbridge Castle cook is in a mess. It is the Duke of Lumbridge's birthday and the cook is making the cake.

He needs a lot of ingredients and doesn't have much time.
Cook's Assistant.items:
* Egg (can be obtained during the quest)
* Bucket of milk
**A bucket (if obtaining the milk during the quest)
* Pot of flour
**A pot (if obtaining the flour during the quest)

Romeo & Juliet.start: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
Romeo & Juliet.description: Romeo and Juliet are desperately in love, but Juliet's father doesn't approve. Help them to find a way to get married and live happily ever after.

Demon Slayer.start: Talk to Aris in the tent on the western side of Varrock Square.
Demon Slayer.description: A mighty demon is being summoned to destroy the city of Varrock. You find out you are the one destined to stop him (or at least try).
Demon Slayer.items:
*A water container, such as a bucket of water (obtainable during the quest)
*25 bones (can't be noted, but can be delivered in increments)
*1 coin

Shield of Arrav.start: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock library, located within the northern end of Varrock Castle.
Shield of Arrav.description: Varrockian literature tells of a valuable shield, stolen long ago from the museum of Varrock, by a gang of professional thieves. See if you can track down this shield and return it to the museum. You will need a friend to help you complete this quest.
Shield of Arrav.items:
*Phoenix Gang: 20 coins
*Black Arm Gang: 2 Phoenix crossbows (obtained during the quest)
Shield of Arrav.enemies:
*Black Arm Gang: Weaponsmaster (level 23)
*Phoenix Gang: Jonny the Beard (level 2)

Sheep Shearer.start: Talk to Fred the Farmer in the house by the sheep pen north of Lumbridge Castle.
Sheep Shearer.description: Fred the Farmer's sheep are getting mighty woolly. He will pay you to shear them.
Sheep Shearer.items:
*20 balls of wool (unnoted)
**Shears if obtaining wool to spin into balls of wool (obtained during the quest)

The Restless Ghost.start: Talk to Father Aereck in the chapel south-east of Lumbridge Castle.
The Restless Ghost.description: A ghost is haunting Lumbridge graveyard. The priest of the Lumbridge church of Saradomin wants you to find out how to get rid of it.

Ernest the Chicken.start: Talk to Veronica, south of Draynor Manor by the gate.
Ernest the Chicken.description: Veronica is very worried. Her fiancé went into the big spooky manor house to ask for directions. An hour later and he's still not out yet.
Ernest the Chicken.items:
* Spade (obtainable during the quest)
* Fish food (obtainable during the quest)
* Poison (obtainable during the quest)

Vampyre Slayer.start: Talk to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village, just north of Ned's house.
Vampyre Slayer.description: The people of Draynor Village live in constant terror. Their numbers are dwindling, all due to the foul creature lurking in the manor to the north known as a vampyre.
Vampyre Slayer.items:
*Hammer (can be bought from the general store just north of the Blue Moon Inn for 1 coin)
* Beer (obtainable during the quest for 2 coins)
* Stake (obtained during the quest)

Imp Catcher.start: Talk to Wizard Mizgog on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower.
Imp Catcher.description: The Wizard Grayzag has summoned hundreds of little imps. They have stolen a lot of things belonging to the Wizard Mizgog including his magic beads.

Prince Ali Rescue.start: Talk to Hassan in the palace at Al Kharid.
Prince Ali Rescue.description: Prince Ali of Al Kharid has been kidnapped by the scheming Lady Keli. You are hired to stage a rescue mission.
Prince Ali Rescue.items:
*Soft clay
*3 balls of wool
*Yellow dye or 2 onions and 5 coins
*Redberries
*Ashes
*Bucket of water or jug of water (obtainable during quest)
*Pot of flour
*Bronze bar
*Pink skirt
*3 beers
*Rope (can be bought during the quest from Ned for 18 coins)
*30-40 coins for the Al Kharid toll gate if not using teleports to and from Al Kharid

Doric's Quest.start: Talk to Doric in the small house north of Falador, just outside the east gate of Taverley.
Doric's Quest.description: Doric the dwarf is happy to let you use his anvils but first he would like you to run an errand for him.
Doric's Quest.items:
* 6 clay (not soft clay)
* 4 copper ores
* 2 iron ores

Black Knights' Fortress.start: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of the White Knights' Castle's western tower in Falador.
Black Knights' Fortress.description: The Black Knights are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon.
Black Knights' Fortress.items:
* Cabbage (can be obtained from the cabbage patch in Edgeville Monastery and South Falador Farm, as well as Lumbridge cellar. Cabbages obtained from Draynor Manor CANNOT be used)
* Iron chainbody (can be purchased at Horvik's Armour Shop in Varrock and from Wayne's Chains in Falador)
* Bronze med helm (can be purchased in the helmet shop in Barbarian Village, spawns by the backdoor of Draynor Manor). Alternatively, a Black full helm, Black platebody and Black platelegs/black plateskirt can be used in place of the Iron chainbody and Bronze med helm.

Witch's Potion.start: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington, south of Falador and west of Port Sarim.
Witch's Potion.description: Become one with your darker side. Tap into your hidden depths of magical potential by making a potion with the help of Hetty the Rimmington witch.
Witch's Potion.items:
*Burnt meat
*Eye of newt
*Onion
*Rat's tail (only obtainable after starting the quest)

The Knight's Sword.start: Talk to the squire in the courtyard of the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
The Knight's Sword.description: Sir Vyvin's squire is in trouble. He has accidentally lost Sir Vyvin's ceremonial sword. Help him find a replacement without Sir Vyvin finding out.
The Knight's Sword.items:
* Redberry pie (not half a redberry pie)
* 2 or 4 iron bars (4 if you want your own blurite sword)
*1-3 Blurite ore (obtained during the quest) - optionally an additional ore each for your own blurite sword and the Falador easy diary (Members only)
* Any pickaxe (one spawns in Rimmington)

Goblin Diplomacy.start: Talk to General Bentnoze or General Wartface in Goblin Village.
Goblin Diplomacy.description: There's a disturbance in the Goblin Village. Help the goblins solve their dispute so the world doesn't have to worry about rioting goblins. Aim: to help the goblins decide which colour they will wear.
Goblin Diplomacy.items:
* 3 sets of Goblin mail (obtained during the quest)
* 1 Blue dye (or 2 woad leaves and 5 coins to obtain a blue dye from Aggie)
** Offer 20 coins to Wyson the gardener and he will give you two woad leaves
* 1 Orange dye – created by combining red dye with yellow dye
** 1 Red dye (or 3 redberries and 5 coins to obtain a red dye from Aggie)
** 1 Yellow dye (2 onions and 5 coins to obtain a yellow dye from Aggie)

Pirate's Treasure.start: Talk to Redbeard Frank at the northernmost dock at Port Sarim, just outside The Rusty Anchor.
Pirate's Treasure.description: Redbeard Frank knows the location of pirate treasure, but he'll only part with the knowledge for a bottle of Karamjan rum.
Pirate's Treasure.items:
*Karamjan rum (obtainable during the quest for 30 coins)
*White apron (obtainable during the quest in Port Sarim at Gerrant's Fishy Business.)
*60 coins (only 30 are needed if using the Ring of Charos(a))
*10 bananas (obtainable during the quest)
*Spade (obtainable during the quest)

Dragon Slayer I.start: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild.
Dragon Slayer I.description: Prove yourself a true champion. Kill the mighty dragon Elvarg of Crandor and earn the right to buy and wear the Rune platebody.
Dragon Slayer I.items:
* Unfired bowl (can be made with soft clay on a Potter's Wheel with link=Crafting|alt=Crafting 8 Crafting)
* Wizard's mind bomb (can be bought in the Rising Sun Inn in Falador or The Toad and Chicken in Burthorpe)
* Lobster pot (can be bought from any fishing shop)
* Silk (can be bought from Thessalia for 30 coins or the Al Kharid silk stall for 3 coins -- members can steal it from the Ardougne silk stall with link=Thieving|alt=Thieving 20 Thieving)
* Magic/ranged weapon as well as a law and air rune (to cast Telekinetic Grab if your Magic level is 33 or higher) or 10,000 coins
* Hammer
* Anti-dragon shield (obtainable during the quest)
* 90 steel nails (Members can buy these from the Sawmill operator north-east of Varrock, they can also be smithed at link=Smithing|alt=Smithing 34 Smithing using 6 steel bars by all players)
* 3 planks (only normal planks work)
** Free-to-play: Buy from Sawmill operator at the sawmill or pick up the spawns in the Graveyard of Shadows, level 19 Wilderness
** Member: Several other spawn locations or buy them at the sawmill
* 2,000 coins
Dragon Slayer I.enemies:
* Zombie rats (level 3)*
* Ghosts (level 19)*
* Skeletons (level 22)*
* Zombies (level 24)*
* Melzar the Mad (level 43)
* Lesser demon (level 82)
* Wormbrain (level 2) - optional
* Elvarg (level 83)
An asterisk denotes that there is only one of each monster that drops the required key. They can be noted by small differences in appearance stated later in the guide.

Druidic Ritual.start: Talk to Kaqemeex in the stone circle north of Taverley.
Druidic Ritual.description: The Druids north of Taverley need help making a potion to reclaim the stone circle south of Varrock.
Druidic Ritual.items:
*Raw bear meat
*Raw rat meat
*Raw beef
*Raw chicken

Lost City.start: Talk to the warrior in the north-western corner of the Lumbridge Swamp.
Lost City.description: Can you find the legendary lost city of Zanaris?
Lost City.items:
* Knife
* Woodcutting axe (you will need to bank the axe before accessing Entrana - you cannot use a blessed axe)
Lost City.enemies:
* Tree Spirit (level 101) (Safespottable)
* Multiple Zombies (level 25) (for a bronze axe)

Witch's House.start: Talk to the boy near the gate entrance of Taverley.
Witch's House.description:
A young boy who lives in Taverley has kicked his ball into the garden of a scary old lady.

He asks you to get it back for him. This proves more difficult than it first sounds.
Witch's House.items:
*Cheese (You may wish to bring several in case you mess up. One source is in Draynor Village - Aggie's house)
*Leather gloves or any of the gloves listed here (obtainable during the quest, may take some time)

Merlin's Crystal.start: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot.
Merlin's Crystal.description: The wizard Merlin has been trapped in a magical crystal by the witch Morgan Le Faye. So far, King Arthur hasn't been able to figure out how to free his mentor from his crystal prison. Can you help?
Merlin's Crystal.items:
*Bread
*Tinderbox
*Bucket of wax (obtainable during the quest with either the Beekeeper's outfit or insect repellent; a bucket spawns near the east gate of the beehive enclosure)
*Bat bones (obtainable during the quest)
Merlin's Crystal.enemies:
* Sir Mordred (level 39)
* Giant bat (level 27) (optional, to acquire bat bones)

Heroes' Quest.start: Talk to Achietties by the entrance to the Heroes' Guild, between Taverley and Burthorpe.
Heroes' Quest.description: Prove you are worthy to enter the Heroes' Guild. To prove your status as a hero you will need to obtain a number of items. There are many challenges standing between you and these items.
Heroes' Quest.items:
* Ice gloves (obtainable during the quest) or Smiths gloves (i)
* Fishing rod (obtainable during the quest)
* Fishing bait (obtainable during the quest)
* Dusty key (obtainable during the quest; if travelling to Taverley Dungeon for the lava eel, without 70 Agility) OR a knife or slash weapon (if travelling to the Lava Maze for the lava eel) OR 60 Sailing level (if travelling to the Charred Dungeon)
* Harralander potion (unf) (or a harralander and a vial of water)
* Pickaxe
If you are a Black Arm Gang member (Note: If you are returning to the mansion after the quest to help another player, you do not need the black armour anymore):
* Black full helm (trimmed will not work)
* Black platebody (trimmed will not work)
* Black platelegs (plateskirt or trimmed will not work)
If you are a Phoenix Gang member:
* Some form of Ranged or Magic attack method
Heroes' Quest.enemies:
* Ice Queen (level 111) (unless you already have Ice Gloves)
* Entrana firebird (level 2)
* Jailer (level 47, optional)
* Grip (level 22) (for Phoenix Gang members only)

Scorpion Catcher.start: Talk to Thormac at the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, south-east of the Ranging Guild.
Scorpion Catcher.description: Thormac the Sorcerer has a hobby involving scorpions. Unfortunately, three of them have escaped and managed to run far away. If you manage to find them all, he may just be able to perform an important service for you.
Scorpion Catcher.items: *Dusty key (obtainable during the quest) or link=Agility|alt=Agility 70 Agility [ boostable ] .
Scorpion Catcher.enemies: * Jailer (level 47) if you need to acquire the dusty key (alternatively, you can skip this if you have access to the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items, where the key is sold)

Family Crest.start: Talk to Dimintheis in south-eastern Varrock.
Family Crest.description: There is a man in Varrock who needs a bit of help. He is of noble heritage, but without his family's crest, he can't prove it. Unfortunately, his three sons took the crest with them when they left, scattering all across Gielinor.
Family Crest.items:
* Shrimps
* Salmon
* Tuna
* Bass
* Swordfish
* Pickaxe - adamant or rune (41+ Mining) highly recommended
* 2 cut rubies
* Ring mould
* Necklace mould
* Any poison cure (you will lose this item). Does not need to contain full doses.
* Means to cast all 4 Blast spells

Fishing Contest.start: Talk to Austri east of White Wolf Mountain or Vestri to the west of it, by either tunnel entrance.
Fishing Contest.description: The mountain Dwarves' home would be an ideal way to get across White Wolf Mountain safely. However, the Dwarves aren't too fond of strangers. They will let you through if you can bring them a trophy. The trophy is the prize for the annual Hemenster fishing competition.
Fishing Contest.items:
*Spade
*5 coins (10 if you buy a fishing rod from Jack)
*Garlic (obtainable during quest)
*Fishing rod or Pearl fishing rod (oily fishing rod does not work)
*Red vine worm (obtainable during quest)

Tribal Totem.start: Talk to Kangai Mau at The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven.
Tribal Totem.description: Lord Handelmort of Ardougne is a collector of exotic artefacts. A recent addition to his private collection is a strange looking totem from Karamja. The Rantuki tribe are not happy about the recent disappearance of their totem.

Monk's Friend.start: Talk to Brother Omad at the Ardougne Monastery south of East Ardougne.
Monk's Friend.description: A monk's child has had their blanket stolen. Find the thieves' den and return the blanket, then help Brother Omad organise the drinks for the child's birthday party.
Monk's Friend.items:
* Jug of water
* Regular logs or a regular plank

Temple of Ikov.start: Talk to Lucien at the Flying Horse Inn in the north-western corner of East Ardougne.
Temple of Ikov.description: A mysterious stranger called Lucien asks you to go on a mission deep under the Temple of Ikov in central Kandarin. He wants you to retrieve an artefact known as the Staff of Armadyl. After you retrieve it, the quest doesn't stop there... Are you on the side of good or evil?
Temple of Ikov.items:
* Any bow capable of firing ice arrows (yew bow or better) or any thrown weapon
* 20 unnoted limpwurt roots
*A method of reducing your weight to at least -1kg temporarily:
**Boots of lightness (can be obtained during the quest with a light source and slash weapon, such as a lit candle and knife)
**Other forms of weight-reducing clothing such as the graceful outfit
Temple of Ikov.enemies:
* Fire Warrior of Lesarkus (level 84)
* Guardian of Armadyl (level 43) (Safespottable) - only if siding with Lucien
* Lucien (level 14) - only if siding with the Guardians of Armadyl

Clock Tower.start: Talk to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower south of East Ardougne.
Clock Tower.description: Help the confused Brother Kojo find the missing cogs and fix his clock tower. Search the dungeon using brawn and brains to correctly place the four cogs.
Clock Tower.items:
* Bucket of water (obtainable during quest)
** Alternatively, a Jug of water, Ice gloves, or Smiths gloves (i)

Holy Grail.start: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot.
Holy Grail.description: King Arthur is sending out his knights on a quest for the famous Holy Grail. If you are a Knight of the Round Table go to King Arthur for further orders.

Tree Gnome Village.start: Talk to King Bolren at the centre of the Tree Gnome Village maze.
Tree Gnome Village.description:
The tree gnomes are in trouble. General Khazard's forces are hunting them to extinction.

Find your way through the hedge maze to the gnomes secret treetop village.

Then help the gnomes fight Khazard and retrieve the orbs of protection.
Tree Gnome Village.items:
* 6 normal logs (or an axe, obtainable during the quest by killing goblins in the Tree Gnome Village maze, or retrievable from the canoe station near the north entrance to the maze, if you have one stored)
* Combat equipment
* Food

Fight Arena.start: Talk to Lady Servil west of the Ardougne Monastery, just outside the north-eastern corner of the Gnome Maze.
Fight Arena.description:
The prosperous Servil family have been abducted by the infamous General Khazard. He plans to have the family battle for his entertainment in the Fight Arena.

Can you rescue the Servils before the tyrant has these innocent (not to mention wealthy) civilians slain?

Hazeel Cult.start: Talk to Ceril Carnillean in East Ardougne, just north of the Clock Tower.
Hazeel Cult.description: Discover the truth behind the Carnillean family fortune. Decide for yourself whether to aid the Carnilleans in retrieving stolen goods, or join the Hazeel cult members in their mission to resurrect the infamous Lord Hazeel.

Sheep Herder.start: Talk to Councillor Halgrive outside of the East Ardougne church.
Sheep Herder.description: Dispose of plagued sheep and save Ardougne!

Plague City.start: Talk to Edmond in the most north-western house of East Ardougne.
Plague City.description: The western part of Ardougne has been shut off as a deadly plague sweeps through the people. However, a young woman who went in to try to help those stricken by the illness has disappeared and her parents have become worried.
Plague City.items:
* Dwellberries (Spawns in McGrubor's Wood, squeeze through the loose railing, use A L S , or Telekinetic Grab them. They can be bought from Heckel Funch or Hudo in the Tree Gnome Stronghold or grown with 36 Farming.)
*Rope (Purchasable in the East Ardougne general store, Port Khazard general store, Ned, or a spawn in Karamja general store.)
*Spade (One spawns near Edmond.)
*1-4 buckets of water (four uses required, there is a water source and bucket spawn nearby)
*Hangover cure or the ingredients to make one:
**Chocolate dust
***Chocolate bar
***Knife or pestle and mortar (Knife spawn on the table in the house east of the altar)
**Bucket of milk (Obtained by using a bucket on a dairy cow, one is north of Ardougne, or bought from Hudo or Heckel Funch.)
**Snape grass (Spawns west of the Crafting Guild or the peninsula north-east of Hosidius. It can be grown at 61 Farming. Can also be obtained from killing Tribesmen in Karamja.)
*Picture of Elena (Inside Alrena and Edmond's house)

Sea Slug.start: Talk to Caroline just north of Witchaven.
Sea Slug.description:
Something strange is happening on the Fishing Platform.
Missing fishermen and the presence of dozens of strange sea creatures gives cause for concern.
Investigate the platform, discover the truth before it's too late.
Sea Slug.items: * Swamp paste (made by mixing flour with swamp tar then cooking the mixture on a fire; can also be bought from a Trader crewmember for 75 coins, from Rasolo for 60 coins west of the Fishing Guild, or from the Khazard General Store for 42 coins at full stock)

Waterfall Quest.start: Talk to Almera in her house north-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Waterfall Quest.description: Investigate the death of elven leaders of old. Search for the elf King Baxtorian's tomb and discover the mysterious hidden treasure of the waterfall.
Waterfall Quest.items:
* 6 Air runes
* 6 Earth runes
* 6 Water runes
* Rope

Jungle Potion.start: Talk to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai.
Jungle Potion.description: Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai Village requires that you collect five special jungle herbs for a potion so he can commune with his gods.

The Grand Tree.start: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree.
The Grand Tree.description: The Grand Tree, which shelters the majority of the small gnome population of Gielinor, is dying. Is it human sabotage or an inside job? Help King Shareen to find the true cause and save the tree gnomes from an uncertain fate.
The Grand Tree.items: * 1,000 coins if you previously chose not to help Femi on your first entry to the Tree Gnome Stronghold (not required if you never used the gate entrance)

Underground Pass.start: Talk to King Lathas on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Ardougne Castle.
Underground Pass.description: There are rumours of a secret passageway that can be used to get to the other side of the mountains west of Ardougne. Now it's just a matter of finding it.
Underground Pass.items:
* Rope (2 recommended)
* Bow
* 1-5 arrows (only non-poisoned arrows with metal arrowtips will work. Craw's bow does not work. Crossbows and bolts will not work. Broad arrows, Ogre arrows, Ice arrows, and Training Arrows will also not work.)
* Spade
* Bucket (obtainable during quest)
* Tinderbox (obtainable during quest)
Underground Pass.enemies:
* 3 demons Doomion, Othainian, and Holthion (level 91) (easily safespottable)
* 3 Paladins (level 62) (easily safespottable)
* Kalrag (level 89) (safespottable) (won't hit with Protect from Melee)
* Disciple of Iban (level 13)

Observatory Quest.start: Talk to the Observatory professor in the Observatory Reception Room north of Castle Wars.
Observatory Quest.description: The Observatory in south-west Ardougne has been ransacked by a family of nearby goblins. Can you help the professor to rebuild it?
Observatory Quest.items:
* 3 normal planks
* Bronze bar
* Molten glass
Observatory Quest.enemies: * Goblin guard (level 42) (Optional – can simply be trapped behind a column)

The Tourist Trap.start: Talk to Irena by the Shantay Pass, south of Al Kharid.
The Tourist Trap.description:
South of Al Kharid a new desert pass has opened up, leading to the dangers of the Kharid desert.
Equip your desert garb and make sure your waterskin is full before heading off into the trackless dunes in search of desert adventure.
The Tourist Trap.items:
Note that all of the required items can be bought from Shantay at the Shantay Pass.
* Desert shirt, robe, and boots (black versions do not work)
* A hammer
* One bronze bar (recommended to bring at least 2 additional bars, 24-96% chance to succeed based on Smithing level)
* Ten feathers (30-50+ recommended at lower Fletching levels)
* Means to enter the desert, such as the Shantay pass, desert amulet 2, teleport tablets or scrolls, fairy rings or the pharaoh's sceptre

Watchtower.start: Talk to the Watchtower Wizard in the Watchtower north of Yanille; you must climb the trellis on the north side of the tower.
Watchtower.description: The Wizards of the Yanille Watch Tower have been reporting increased ogre sightings recently. Use a wide variety of your skills to help the wizards recover their stolen power crystals and stop the advance of the ogre hordes!
Watchtower.items:
* 20 coins
* Gold bar
* Tinderbox
* Death rune (obtainable during the quest)
* Pickaxe
* Dragon bones (baby dragon bones will not work)
* 2 ropes (2nd rope obtainable during the quest)
* Guam potion (unf)
**Guam leaf and vial of water if making your own potion (vial obtainable during the quest)
* Any light source (obtainable during the quest)
* Pestle and mortar (obtainable during the quest)
* Bat bones (obtainable during the quest with a knife or slash weapon, grinding the bat bones before starting the quest to leave the pestle and mortar in the bank is also an option)
* Jangerberries (obtainable during the quest)
Watchtower.enemies:
* Gorad (level 68) (safespottable)
* Giant bat (level 27) (only if bat bones are needed)

Dwarf Cannon.start: Talk to Captain Lawgof, south of the Coal Trucks, north-west of the Fishing Guild.
Dwarf Cannon.description:
For several years now, the Dwarven Black Guard have been developing the latest in projectile warfare.

With the constant attack of goblin renegades, the dwarven troops who protect the mines need to put this secret weapon into action.

Only with your help can the true power of this cannon be harnessed!

Murder Mystery.start: Talk to any guard around the Sinclair Mansion, north of Seers' Village and Camelot.
Murder Mystery.description: Old man Sinclair has been found dead in his mansion! Unfortunately, the local authorities are having some trouble figuring out who's the guilty party. Maybe the unbiased eye of a passing adventurer will be of help.

The Dig Site.start: Talk to an examiner in the Exam Centre south of the Digsite.
The Dig Site.description:
Feeling uneducated? Desperate for buried treasure?

"There's gold in them there hills" (well stream actually) as well as many other items that can be found at the digsite. Join the students in their attempt to be a qualified archaeologist, and become experienced in making the earth move!

Have you got what it takes to unearth the hidden altar to one of Gielinor's lesser-known Gods?
The Dig Site.items:
* Pestle and mortar
* Vial
* Tinderbox
* Cup of tea (can be stolen from the Varrock tea stall) or nettle tea or cup of tea (nettle)
* 2 ropes
* Opal or uncut opal (small chance to acquire while panning for a quest item)
* Charcoal (obtainable during the quest, but may take some time)
* Specimen brush (obtained during the quest)
* Specimen jar (obtained during the quest)
* Panning tray (obtained during the quest)
* Trowel (obtained during the quest)

Gertrude's Cat.start: Talk to Gertrude in her house just west of Varrock.
Gertrude's Cat.description: Gertrude has lost her cat Fluffs and desperately wants to find her. Can you help bring her home?
Gertrude's Cat.items:
* Bucket of milk
* 100 coins
* Seasoned sardine (Bought from the Grand Exchange) or alternatively:
** Raw sardine (can be bought from Gerrant's Fishy Business.)
** Doogle leaves (obtainable during the quest)

Legends' Quest.start: Talk to the Legends' Guards just outside of the Legends' Guild.
Legends' Quest.description: Only the elite are allowed to call themselves a member of the Legends' Guild. Do you have what it takes to make it in?
Legends' Quest.items:
* Any machete (obtainable during the quest)
* 2 gold bars (6 in case you fail or want more gold bowls)
* Hammer or Imcando hammer
* Rope
* Rune, Dragon or Infernal axe
* Lockpick (2 in case you fail) (Strange old lockpick does not work)
* Pickaxe
* Vial of water
* Ardrigal (obtainable during the quest)
* Snake weed (obtainable during the quest)
* One of each cut gem up to diamond:
** Sapphire
** Emerald
** Ruby
** Diamond
** Opal
** Jade
** Red topaz
* Soul rune
* Mind rune
* 2 law runes
* Earth rune
* Unpowered orb and runes to cast any Charge Orb once (requires the standard spellbook equipped - note that at Magic level 56 you can only cast the Charge Water Orb spell - two casts are needed if taking the "long path" during the second fight with the demon)
* Charcoal (2-3 in case it breaks -- obtainable during the quest if travelling via Shilo Village)
Legends' Quest.enemies:
* Ranalph Devere (level 92) — 2 times
* Irvig Senay (level 100) — 2 times
* San Tojalon (level 106) — 2 times
* Nezikchened (level 187) — 3 times

Rogue Trader.start: Speak to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid
Rogue Trader.items:
*3 dyes of any colour (to unlock Menaphite clothing) OR 3 animal pelts of the same kind (to unlock the Desert outfit). This includes cowhide, grey wolf fur, snakeskin, bear fur, or wool (not balls of wool)
*100 coins (for blackjack street urchin, optional)

Rune Mysteries.start: Talk to Duke Horacio on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Lumbridge Castle.
Rune Mysteries.description: After the first Wizards' Tower burned down a hundred years ago, the incantation allowing teleportation to the rune essence mine was lost. However, after much research from the Order of Wizards, the incantation is on the verge of rediscovery...
Rune Mysteries.items: *Air talisman (is given for free at the start of the quest)

Death Plateau.start: Talk to Denulth in his tent in Burthorpe.
Death Plateau.description:
Trolls have come down from the north and are camped on Death Plateau. They are using this base to launch attacks on the principality of Burthorpe!
The Imperial Guard is taking heavy losses. They need your help!
Death Plateau.items:
* 60 coins (bring 1000 for the gambling dice with Harold part)
*10 unnoted bread
*10 unnoted cooked trout
*Iron bar
*Asgarnian ale (can be found on the bar at the pub in Burthorpe)

Eadgar's Ruse.start: Talk to Sanfew on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the herbalist shop in Taverley.
Eadgar's Ruse.description:
Sanfew requires a rare herb for the next part of the purifying ritual.

Travel back to the Troll Stronghold to find this herb that the trolls use as an ingredient for their favourite dish.
Eadgar's Ruse.items:
* Climbing boots (or 12 coins to buy from Tenzing)
* Vodka (sold by Heckel Funch at the Tree Gnome Stronghold bar for 5 coins)
* Pineapple chunks (pineapples are sold by Heckel Funch at the Tree Gnome Stronghold bar or any Charter Ship, use a knife to dice the pineapple into chunks)
* 1 Log (2 logs and a tinderbox are recommended)
* 10 Grain (obtainable during the quest, just south of Tegid in Taverley, or North of East Ardougne after visiting the zoo)
* 5 Raw chicken (there are chickens on the way at Tenzing the Sherpa's house, or between East Ardougne and Witchaven. Undead chickens do not work.)
* Pestle and mortar
* Ranarr potion (unf)

Big Chompy Bird Hunting.start: Talk to Rantz by the eastern coast of Feldip Hills, east of fairy ring A K S .
Big Chompy Bird Hunting.description:
Rantz the Ogre needs to feed his demanding children, Fycie and Bugs, so he wants to go Big Chompy Bird hunting. Problem is, he's all fingers and thumbs when it comes to making ogre arrows.

Could someone please give him a hand?
Big Chompy Bird Hunting.items:
* Any axe that you can use (Blessed axe does not work)
* Feathers (100 to be safe; coloured feathers from link=Hunter|alt=Hunter Hunter work)
** Bringing 50 to buy 25 feathers from Fycie also works
* Knife (or 10 to buy a knife and chisel from Bugs)
* Chisel (or 10 to buy a knife and chisel from Bugs)
* 4 wolf bones (obtainable during the quest from level 65 wolves or from level 14 wolves in the Stronghold of Security)
* Cabbage (obtainable during the quest, Draynor cabbage will not work)
* Tomato (obtainable during the quest)
* Onion (obtainable during the quest)
* Potato (obtainable during the quest)
* Equa leaves (obtainable during the quest)
* Doogle leaves (obtainable during the quest)

Elemental Workshop I.start: Search the bookcase in the house immediately south-west of the Seers' Village bank.
Elemental Workshop I.description:
Hundreds of years ago, a mineral was found that had the ability to change the property of Magic.

The magicians, fearing the effect this may have on their profession, sealed this Workshop forever; or so they had hoped. See if you can rediscover the lost knowledge of elemental ore.
Elemental Workshop I.items:
* Knife (obtainable during the quest) or a slash weapon (e.g. dagger or scimitar)
* Pickaxe
* Needle (obtainable during the quest, Costume needle works if you have thread)
* Thread
* Leather (obtainable during the quest)
* Hammer
* 4 coal (4 more for each additional bar you would like to produce)

Nature Spirit.start: Talk to Drezel in the basement of the Paterdomus Temple by the northern end of the River Salve.
Nature Spirit.description:
After saving the holy man Drezel, he's seeking some assistance again.
This time he has a special request for any adventurous sorts to search for the Druid 'Filliman Tarlock' and brave the terrors that infest the swamp of Mort Myre.
Nature Spirit.items:
* Silver sickle
* Ghostspeak amulet
* 6 empty inventory spaces

Priest in Peril.start: Talk to King Roald in the Varrock Palace.
Priest in Peril.description: Recently contact has been lost with the temple to Saradomin on Misthalins' Eastern border. King Roald would be very interested to know what has caused this lack of communication, and seeks an adventurer willing to report back to him on the situation.
Priest in Peril.items:
* 50 unnoted rune essence or pure essence (can be mined by talking to Aubury in Varrock, after completing Rune Mysteries. All 50 essence do not have to be of the same type) (does not needed to be handed in all at once; multiple trips can be made.)
* Bucket (obtainable during the quest from Varrock general store for 2 coins)
Priest in Peril.enemies:
* Temple guardian dog (level 30) - can be safespotted or flinched, immune to Magic
* Monk of Zamorak (level 30) - can be safespotted or flinched

Regicide.start: Talk to King Lathas on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Ardougne Castle.
Regicide.description:
Continuing the Plague City series, the Regicide Quest takes you beyond the 'Well of Voyage' to a new realm.

King Lathas will employ you once again, this time for the grim task of disposing of his brother.

Upon travelling to the realm you will find yourself surrounded by new and strange plants, animals and even a new race.

Once there, you will see that everything is not as serene as it first appears.
Regicide.items:
* 5 coal in the bank (although at least 25 is recommended; you may bring the coal noted to save you a bank trip)
* Bow and some arrows (or lit fire arrows if you already have some.)
* 2 ropes (3 in case you fail)
* Spade
* Limestone (or a pickaxe and link=Mining|alt=Mining 10+ Mining ). Note that limestone bricks will not work.
* Tinderbox
* Strip of cloth (made on a loom with 4 balls of wool; not a bolt of cloth - you can use the loom at the Iorwerth Camp or at the Falador farm)
* Pestle and mortar
* Gloves, the list on Quicklime shows all gloves that work.
* Pot (obtainable during quest)
* Cooked rabbit (obtainable during quest) or roast rabbit

Tai Bwo Wannai Trio.start: Talk to Timfraku in his house in Tai Bwo Wannai.
Tai Bwo Wannai Trio.description:
In Jungle Potion, the Shaman Trufitus communed with the gods to determine the fate of his people.

Now, Timfraku, the Chief of Tai Bwo Wannai, wishes to see his people and family return to the abandoned village.

Help a depressed fisherman, encourage a raging hunter and satiate an eccentric priest in this extreme test of aptitude and patience!
Tai Bwo Wannai Trio.items:
* Knife or bladed weapon, such as a Sword or a Spear
* Sliced banana (obtainable during the quest)
* Small fishing net
* Pestle and mortar (obtainable during the quest for 6 gp)
* 2 Logs to quickly make Poison karambwan at fishing site and to cook Pasty jogre bones later in the quest
* Iron spear, Steel spear, Mithril spear, Adamant spear, Rune spear or Dragon spear which will be consumed during the quest.
* Agility potion(4) (must be 4 doses)
* Ranged equipment, Magic equipment, or a halberd to kill a monkey for a monkey corpse (adjacent melee does 0 damage to monkeys)
* Tinderbox (If you wish to avoid running back to the range in Brimhaven)
* Jogre bones (obtainable during the quest)
* Seaweed (obtainable during the quest)
* Karamjan rum or 30 coins to purchase (if obtaining the rum before starting, add the sliced banana or the rum will disappear when you leave the island)

Troll Stronghold.description:
The Imperial Guard raid was a failure, and Dunstan's son has been captured by the trolls!

Journey through Trollheim to the Troll Stronghold, and rescue him!
Troll Stronghold.items: * Climbing boots or 12 coins to buy them
Troll Stronghold.enemies:
* Dad (level 101) (can be safespotted)
* Troll General (level 113) (can be safespotted)
* Berry and Twig (both level 71) (can be safespotted) Only if you have less than link=Thieving|alt=Thieving 30 Thieving or fail to pickpocket them (can be safespotted)

Shades of Mort'ton.start: Search the shelf in the southern-western house of Mort'ton.
Shades of Mort'ton.description: The townsfolk of Mort'ton have some form of strange affliction and the town is full of Shades. Can you find some way to reverse this?
Shades of Mort'ton.items:
* 1000+ coins (bring plenty of money just in case)
* 2 Tarromin potion (unf) OR 2 vials of water and 2 tarromins (both obtainable during the quest)
* 2 ashes
*Tinderbox
*Logs OR an axe to obtain some
* 1 hammer
**Using a Flamtaer hammer is highly recommended in case the minigame is unpopulated, as a regular hammer is insufficient to build the temple alone. An additional 13,000 coins (or 5,236 on the Grand Exchange) allows you to buy a Flamtaer hammer from Razmire.

The Fremennik Trials.start: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the Rellekka longhall.
The Fremennik Trials.description:
Council workmen have at last found the time to make repairs to the footbridge that connects Kandarin with the Barbarian town of Rellekka.

Do you have what it takes to impress the barbarians who live there, and perhaps be welcomed as an honorary member of their clan?
The Fremennik Trials.items:
* 5,252 coins
* Beer tankard or Beer (obtainable during quest)
* Tinderbox
* Either a raw shark, raw manta ray, or raw sea turtle
* Lyre, obtainable as a drop from Lanzig, Borrokar, Lensa, or Freidir, or the skills and materials to make one:
** link=Fletching|alt=Fletching 25 Fletching , link=Woodcutting|alt=Woodcutting 40 Woodcutting , and link=Crafting|alt=Crafting 40 Crafting (all boostable)
** Woodcutting axe
** Knife
** Potato (obtainable during quest)
** Onion (obtainable during quest)
** Cabbage (obtainable during quest)
The Fremennik Trials.enemies:
* Koschei the deathless (first three forms)
* Draugen (level 69)
OPTIONAL
* Lanzig, Borrokar, Lensa, or Freidir (level 48) (multiple times)

Horror from the Deep.start: Talk to Larrissa outside the Lighthouse north of Barbarian Outpost.
Horror from the Deep.description:
The lighthouse protecting Kandarin's north-western coastline has mysteriously stopped operating, and contact with the lighthouse keeper Jossik has been lost.

The Council would greatly appreciate it if somebody could discover for them what has happened to this most vital landscape feature.
Horror from the Deep.items:
*Fire rune
*Air rune
*Water rune
*Earth rune
*Any sword or longsword that you are willing to lose (except rusty sword and prop sword)
*Any arrow (except ogre arrows and training arrows)
*Molten glass
*Tinderbox
*Hammer
* 60 steel nails
* 2 regular planks (can be obtained from Barbarian Outpost)
*Swamp tar
*At least one combat style to defeat the Dagannoth Mother - she cycles every 18 seconds between only being vulnerable to one of six different types of attack
**Highly recommended to bring means to deal damage with all of the elemental Magic types (air, water, earth, and fire spells)
**You may also bring means to deal Ranged and Melee damage (she has high resistance to melee)
Horror from the Deep.enemies:
* Dagannoth (Horror from the Deep) (level 100) (can be completely safespotted)
* Dagannoth Mother (level 100) (with use of a safespot and Protect from Missiles, all damage can be negated)

Throne of Miscellania.start: Talk to King Vargas in the Miscellania Castle.
Throne of Miscellania.description:
Rumours have been coming back from Miscellania that all is not well, it is said that the king has been turned into a monster!

An exceptional hero is required to investigate. Experience in ruling kingdoms, wooing royalty, and negotiating peace would be an advantage.
Throne of Miscellania.items:
* Iron bar
* Any common, non-silver ring (such as a gold ring) that you're willing to lose (not onyx/dragonstone/explorer/beacon/'perfect' ring/nature/pineapple/Charos/fremennik/ancient/key)
*At least one of the following to gain favour during the quest
** 1,875 to buy flowers from Flower Girl (fastest method, but click intensive)
**An axe and link=Woodcutting|alt=Woodcutting 45 Woodcutting to cut maple trees (slower, but more AFK than buying flowers manually, since one click yields multiple logs and therefore multiple instances of favour)
**A rake and link=Farming|alt=Farming 10 Farming to rake flax
**A pickaxe and link=Mining|alt=Mining 35 Mining to mine coal
**A harpoon or lobster pot and link=Fishing|alt=Fishing 35 Fishing to fish tuna, lobsters or swordfish
* Logs (obtainable during the quest if you bring an axe)

Monkey Madness I.start: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree.
Monkey Madness I.description:
The King of the northern Gnomes, Narnode Shareen, is once again in need of your help. He recently decided to send an envoy of his Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommissioning of the Gnome owned ship-building facilities on the eastern coast of Karamja.

It has been quite some time since the 10th squad were dispatched and they have been deemed missing in action. It will be up to you, should you decide to help, to find out what fate befell the 10th squad and if possible, track them d
Monkey Madness I.items:
* A gold bar
* Five empty inventory slots
* A ball of wool
* Monkey bones or corpse from Karamja (obtainable during quest)
* Five bananas (obtainable during quest)

Haunted Mine.start: Talk to the Zealot by the Abandoned Mine in the south-western corner of Morytania.
Haunted Mine.description:
Recent forays into Morytania by some of Saradomin's more fanatical supporters have unearthed murky rumours concerning an abandoned mine in the south.

Legend speaks of an unusual material, hidden in the depths of the mines, that is somehow linked to the desolation and fear that now surrounds the place. Do you have the nerve to find out more, and enter the haunted mines of Morytania?

Troll Romance.start: Talk to Ug at the Troll Stronghold.
Troll Romance.description: Ug loves Aga, but Aga is together with Arrg. Since Arrg is a lot stronger than Ug, Ug can't follow the regular mating ritual, which involves ripping the opponent into pieces. Will you be able to find out what will impress the troll female more than a display of violence? Will you survive the journey to help a lonely troll find love?
Troll Romance.items:
* An iron bar
* Maple or yew logs
* Rope
* Climbing boots (not needed if using Trollheim Teleport)
* Wax (can be made ahead of time)
** A bucket of wax (use insect repellent on a beehive followed by a bucket)
** A cake tin
** Swamp tar
Troll Romance.enemies: Arrg (level 113) (safespottable; difficult to reach) Note: This fight is not a safe death.

In Search of the Myreque.start: Talk to Vanstrom Klause at the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis.
In Search of the Myreque.description: Canifis is experiencing an upsurge in new faces and a new stranger has appeared with a job to track down some local heroes known only as "The Myreque". The Myreque are fighting a desperate battle against the darkness of Morytania and he wishes to take them weapons to aid in the battle. Can you help him out?
In Search of the Myreque.items:
* A steel longsword
* 2 steel swords
* A steel mace
* A steel warhammer
* A steel dagger
* 225 steel nails
* A Druid pouch containing at least 5 charges (3 charges must be added per fill)
**6 Mort myre fungus OR 3 Mort myre pear OR 3 Mort myre stem to fill the pouch
**A Silver sickle (b) to collect these items for the charges if not buying from the Grand Exchange
* A hammer or Imcando hammer
* 6 normal planks
* 10 coins or a Ring of Charos(a)

Creature of Fenkenstrain.start: Read the signpost in the middle of Canifis.
Creature of Fenkenstrain.description:
Dr Fenkenstrain, master and sole occupant of the castle to the north-east of Canifis, needs a new servant to go on a dark errand for him.

Do you have the stomach to help Fenkenstrain complete his twisted purpose?
Creature of Fenkenstrain.items:
* Ghostspeak amulet
* Silver bar
* 3 bronze wire (unnoted)
* Needle (costume needle does not work)
* 5 thread
* Spade
* 50 coins OR 1 law & 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab (requires link=Magic|alt=Magic 33 Magic )
Creature of Fenkenstrain.enemies: * Experiment (level 51) - can be safespotted or flinched

Roving Elves.start: Talk to Islwyn inside the elven woods of Isafdar.
Roving Elves.description: Deep in the elven forests of Isafdar, live a duo of roving elves: Islwyn, a grumpy, old elf who dislikes humans and his companion, Eluned, who is a beautiful, friendly, young female elf with a kind heart. In this quest, you are challenged to overcome Islwyn's prejudice against humans and alleviate the burdens of the past.
Roving Elves.items:
* Glarial's pebble (obtainable during the quest)
* Key (obtainable during the quest)
* Spade
* Rope
Roving Elves.enemies: * Moss Guardian (level 84) (has to be killed with restricted items, can be flinched)

Ghosts Ahoy.start: Talk to Velorina in Port Phasmatys.
Ghosts Ahoy.description: East of Canifis is a ghost port. Not meaning that it's deserted. It's full of ghosts! For some reason, they're unable to pass on to the afterlife, but some aren't happy with that. Can you help?
Ghosts Ahoy.items:
* Some amount of Ecto-tokens:
** 31 Ecto-tokens (16 with Ring of Charos(a))
** OR 25 Ecto-tokens (10 with ring) using charter ships
** OR 1 bone, 1 pot, and 1 bucket for every 5 ecto-tokens required (see Pre-quest for more info)
* ~400 Coins
* Ghostspeak amulet
* Bucket of milk
* Silk
* 3 colours of dye (The dye colours you will need are random. If you want to save a trip, have 3 red, 3 blue, and 3 yellow dyes. That way, you can mix whatever colours you end up needing.)
*Spade
*Oak longbow
*Knife (can be purchased from the Canifis general store)
*Needle and thread (can be purchased from the Canifis general store) or a costume needle
* One extra bucket of slime for colouring the bed sheet (can be purchased from a Charter ship crewmember at the port).
* Nettle tea (prepared ahead of time, within a bowl of water) or items to make nettle tea:
** A tinderbox and a log of which you have the Firemaking level to light. Tinderbox can be purchased from the general store during quest
**Gloves (must be closed fingered - Slayer gloves, Ranger gloves, Infinity gloves, Moonclan gloves, Granite gloves, Lunar gloves and Beekeeper's gloves won't work)
**Nettles (obtainable during the quest)
**Bowl of water (empty bowl can be purchased during quest -- the gold bowl won't work)

One Small Favour.start: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village.
One Small Favour.description:
If you're new to Shilo Village after solving the mystery (or even if you did it some time ago), you may like to check out Yanni Salika's antiques shop.

He's a busy chap, revamping antique items, checking out new stock from potential adventurers and maybe he'll have a small (1) favour to ask of you? Probably nothing particularly large, Yanni isn't a demanding (2) person, should hardly take you any time (3) at all really, something to do when you have a spare moment.

That's assuming there aren't
One Small Favour.items:
* 4 steel bars
* Bronze bar
* Iron bar
* The ingredients required to make a Guthix rest:
** 2 Guam leaves
** Marrentill
** Harralander
** Cup of hot water (obtainable during the quest)
* Hammer (obtainable during the quest) or Imcando hammer
* 5 pigeon cages (obtainable during the quest)
** Note: The pigeons do not need to be let out of the cages.
* Pot (obtainable during the quest)
* Soft clay (obtained during the quest)
* Two of each of the following cut gems, or a chisel to cut the uncut gems received during the quest (high chance to crush them, up to 2 replacements available for 500 coins each during the quest)
** Opal
** Jade
** Red topaz
** Sapphire (cannot be crushed, so you may choose to bring a chisel instead to cut the uncut sapphires given during the quest)

Mountain Daughter.start: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp east of Rellekka (to access the camp, see below)
Mountain Daughter.description: Ages ago, a small tribe of people split off from the Fremennik in Rellekka and decided to inhabit the mountains to the east of town. There they lived as nomads for many years, but now the chieftain of the camp has lost his daughter and will not move on before she has been found. Has she run away, has she been eaten by trolls, or is there something more sinister going on? Only you can find out.
Mountain Daughter.items:
* Rope
* Pickaxe
* Axe
* Plank
* Staff or a pole (obtainable during the quest, Dramen Staff does not work, but elemental staves and Lunar staff do work)
* Gloves (excluding: Slayer, Ranger, Moonclan, Lunar, vambraces, mystic and random event apparel)

Between a Rock....start: Talk to Dondakan the Dwarf at the Keldagrim south-west mine.
Between a Rock....description: Hidden away from the fearsome trolls and the roaming Fremennik, the dwarves delve deep beneath the mountains in search for the ore they need to support their home of Keldagrim. One dwarf in particular, however, has for years been trying to crack open a rock that seems to be impervious to any material that he's tried on it. Convinced that solving the riddle of the rock will lead him to unimaginable wealth, he has spent the later part of his life on just this lump of stone. Help him out, but take
Between a Rock....items:
* A pickaxe
* 4 gold bars (You will need an extra bar and telegrab if you want to keep a golden cannonball for after the quest)
* A hammer
* An ammo mould (can be bought for 5 coins during the quest) or a double ammo mould
* ~830 coins (for cart and ferry)

The Feud.start: Talk to Ali Morrisane east of the Gem Trader in northern Al Kharid.
The Feud.description:
Ali Morrisane - Gielinor's self proclaimed 'greatest merchant' - is having difficulties. He is selling things at such a rate that he cannot keep his market stall in stock.

Word has it that he is on the lookout for someone; someone who can recruit some help from his home town Pollnivneach - a somewhat anarchic place, south of the Shantay Pass.
The Feud.items:
* 501+ coins
* Gloves - (see this page for gloves that do work; Barrows gloves, ice gloves, vambraces, and Slayer gloves do not work!)
* Kharidian headpiece (can be bought from Ali Morrisane)
* Fake beard (can be bought from Ali Morrisane)
* 3 beers (obtainable during the quest, bought from Ali the Barman for 2 coins each)
* Bucket or Ugthanki dung (obtainable during the quest, spawns at the location it is needed – bring three extra buckets, four total, if you plan on doing My Arm's Big Adventure as three Ugthanki dung are needed for that quest). One more might be needed for Forgettable Tale... (1/25 chance for each player).
* Snake charm (obtainable during the quest by putting a coin in the snake charmer's money pot, if you do not already have one in your bank)
** If you have the snake charm in your bank already, you will need to retrieve it.
* Snake basket (obtainable during quest by putting a coin in the snake charmer's money pot, whether or not you have one in your bank)

The Golem.start: Talk to the clay golem in the ruins of Uzer, east of the Shantay Pass in the Kharidian Desert.
The Golem.description:
Deep in the desert stand the ruins of the once great city of Uzer, where a lone survivor, an ancient clay golem, forever paces back and forth. It is badly damaged, and its mind cannot rest until it has completed the task for which it was created.

It is up to you to uncover the secret of the lost city, and add the final chapter to a story started in the violence of the Third Age.
The Golem.items:
* Vial
* Pestle and mortar
* Papyrus (can be bought from Ali Morrisane for 10gp)
* 4 soft clay (or a bracelet of clay and a pickaxe to mine north-west of the ruins)
* Phoenix feather (can be obtained north-west of the ruins)
* Means to enter the desert (such as the Shantay pass, Teleport tablets or scrolls, Fairy rings or the Pharaoh's sceptre)

Desert Treasure I.start: Talk to Asgarnia Smith at the Bedabin Camp.
Desert Treasure I.description:
Rumours abound throughout Varrock and Al Kharid that an archaeologist has discovered clues to a hoard of treasure hidden deep in the desert, south of Al Kharid.

Anybody prepared to offer him assistance in his treasure hunting could well find themselves benefitting from a very large reward indeed...
Desert Treasure I.items:
* 10+ Shantay passes or a way to enter the Kharidian Desert without one
* 650 Coins
* 12 Magic logs (can be noted)
* 6 Steel bar (can be noted)
* 6 Molten glass (can be noted)
* Ashes
* Charcoal
* 1 blood rune
* Bones (can be noted to prevent accidental burial)
* A silver bar
* Garlic powder (made by grinding garlic in a pestle and mortar)
* Spice (gnome spice and Evil Dave's spices will not work)
* A sweet (cake, chocolate cake (part cakes are accepted), chocolate bar, cooking apple, or pineapple pizza)
* Spiked boots (obtainable during the quest by bringing Dunstan climbing boots and an iron bar; do so before attempting to obtain the ice diamond)
* Climbing boots (if Eadgar's Ruse isn't completed and/or you lack 61 Magic for the Trollheim Teleport)
* A facemask, slayer helmet, or gas mask
* A tinderbox
* 20-50+ lockpicks
Desert Treasure I.enemies:
* Dessous (level 139)
* 5 ice trolls (level 120-124)
* Kamil (level 154)
* Fareed (level 167)
* Damis (2 forms, levels 103 and 174)
* You will also need to tank hits by many high level enemies throughout most parts of the quest.

Icthlarin's Little Helper.start: Talk to the wanderer in the camp west of the Agility Pyramid.
Icthlarin's Little Helper.description:
In the deep south of the desert, unrest is brewing... The cities of the Menaphites have barred their gates to all. An unsettling desert wanderer may know of a secret entrance though, to Sophanem - the city of the dead.

Will you become Icthlarin's Little Helper by entering? Enter into a titanic struggle for the soul of the high priest of Icthlarin in a land where the cat is top dog.
Icthlarin's Little Helper.items:
* Regular or overgrown cat, hellcat, or kitten. No food is required as the kitten can stay in your inventory for the most part, or automatically go in/out of your inventory.
* Tinderbox
* Willow log
* Bag of salt (can be bought from any Slayer Master, other players, or the Grand Exchange) or an empty bucket to obtain a pile of salt in Sophanem
* Bucket of sap (use a knife on an evergreen tree or a regular tree with the description "a commonly found tree" with a bucket in your inventory)
* Full waterskin to give away (can be bought for 30 coins at Shantay pass)
* Linen (Can be bought on The Grand Exchange or bought from Raetul in Sophanem for 30 coins during the quest)
* Means to enter the desert. (Such as the Shantay pass, Teleport tablets or scrolls, Fairy rings or the Pharaoh's sceptre)
Icthlarin's Little Helper.enemies:
* Possessed Priest (level 91)
* One of the level 75–81 guardians (chosen based on your stats):
** Apparition#Apmeken (level 75)—uses Magic
** Apparition#Crondis (level 75)—uses Magic
** Apparition#Scabaras (level 75)—uses Melee
** Apparition#Het (level 81)—uses Melee
It is possible to know in advance which of these guardians you're going to get, based on which jar your character obtains during the quest. See the "Second Flashback" section below.

Tears of Guthix.start: Talk to Juna, deep inside the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Tears of Guthix.description: Deep in the caves in the Lumbridge Swamp is an enchanted place where the tears shed by Guthix when it saw the destruction Saradomin and Zamorak had caused with their wars flow from the very walls. These tears are said to have magical properties to help players gain deeper understanding of the world. However, the cave is guarded by a loyal serpent named Juna who blocks passage from everyone. However, she has grown bored from three thousand years of sitting in the dark cave and wishes to hear stor
Tears of Guthix.items:
* Lit sapphire lantern or the materials to make one
** Bullseye lantern or bullseye lantern (unf) (filled with lamp oil at the chemist in Rimmington or the lamp still in Dorgesh-Kaan)
** Cut sapphire
** Tinderbox
* Chisel
* Pickaxe
* Rope (if you have not yet entered the Lumbridge Swamp Caves)

The Lost Tribe.start: Talk to Sigmund in Lumbridge Castle.
The Lost Tribe.description:
Sigmund is the advisor to the Duke of Lumbridge, but the Duke does not always take his advice.

When part of the cellar wall collapses the Duke insists the damage was caused by an earthquake, but Sigmund is worried about a monster attack.

If you investigate this mystery it will lead you through treacherous caves to uncover something lost by the Gods for thousands of years.
The Lost Tribe.items:
* Pickaxe
* Light source (Note: Candles, torches, and oil lamps can cause swamp gas explosions if going off-route, and need a tinderbox to stay lit)

The Giant Dwarf.start: Talk to the Dwarven Boatman by the underground River Kelda, accessible through the Keldagrim entrance east of Rellekka, in the cave beyond the statues.
The Giant Dwarf.description:
Five hundred years have passed since the rule of King Alvis, saviour of Keldagrim and victim of his own inventions.

He founded the Consortium: the gathering of Mining companies that were to serve the monarchy. But, eventually, the monarchy came to serve the Consortium.

By the time of his death, the monarchy was all but abolished. Now the Kings in Keldagrim are but a distant memory... with only the statue of King Alvis to remind the people of the old days, the dark days.

So begins the Rise of
The Giant Dwarf.items:
* 200 coins for the clothes
* Means to cast Telekinetic Grab (air and law rune)
* Logs (most logs will work, however, arctic pine, redwood & coloured logs do not work)
* Tinderbox
* Coal (obtainable during the quest with 30 Mining)
* Iron bar
* 3 cut sapphires
* Various ores and bars (mostly obtainable during the quest, see below)
* Redberry pie

Recruitment Drive.start: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of the White Knights' Castle's western tower in Falador.
Recruitment Drive.description: The Temple Knights of Saradomin, a secret organisation founded many centuries ago by Saradomin himself, are currently looking to expand their ranks with some new blood. After the successful thwarting of the Black Knights' plans to take over Asgarnia, and with the personal recommendation of Sir Amik, you have now been offered the chance to apply for membership in this organisation... but are you up to the challenge?

Mourning's End Part I.start: Talk to Eluned inside the elven woods of Isafdar.
Mourning's End Part I.description:
It seems at last Arianwyn has need of your skills.

He believes there is more to the Mourners than meets the eye and he wishes for you to find out just what they're up to. Can you gain the trust of the Mourners?
Mourning's End Part I.items:
*Bear fur (obtainable during the quest near Jorral's Outpost)
*2 silk
*Each of these dyes: red, yellow, green, and blue (can be bought during the quest for 6 coins each at the Lletya Seamstress).
** You may want to bring additional dyes to collect multiple coloured toads in case you miss when firing the device.
*Bucket of water (can be bought from the general store in Lletya during the quest, and used on the well)
*Feather
*Rotten apple (must be the rotten apple on the ground north of the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne, obtainable during the quest)
*Toad crunchies or Premade t'd crunch
*Magic logs
*Leather
*Ogre bellows (obtainable during the quest)
*Barrel of naphtha, or 5-9 coal to make one
*7 empty inventory spaces for the Mourner gear
Mourning's End Part I.enemies: Mourner (level 11) (will decrease all combat skills to 20, including Hitpoints)

Forgettable Tale....start: Talk to Commander Veldaban in the Dwarven Black Guard headquarters in Keldagrim.
Forgettable Tale....description:
Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf is part 2 in the Rise of the Red Axe series, focusing on the dwarves and their capital city of Keldagrim. After the events in The Giant Dwarf, the Red Axe mining company has departed the city and set up a new headquarters in a remote underground location.

Veldaban, the Commander of the Dwarven Black Guard in Keldagrim, wants you to investigate the case and find out if the Red Axe is planning anything nefarious. The problem is, the only lead he's got is an ext
Forgettable Tale....items:
*~400 coins
*2 barley malt (no range in Keldagrim, plain barley has to be cooked elsewhere)
*2 buckets of water
*Seed dibber (no Tool leprechaun in Keldagrim) or partial completion of the Farming portion of the Barbarian Training miniquest
*Rake (obtainable during the quest)
*Ale yeast (or a Pot (obtainable during the quest) + 25 coins)
*Kebab (purchasable during quest for 1 coin)
*2 beers (purchasable during quest for 1-2 coins each)
*Beer glass (obtainable during the quest)
*A random item from the list below (see list for details)

Garden of Tranquillity.start: Talk to Queen Ellamaria in the garden of Varrock Palace.
Garden of Tranquillity.description:
'Queen of Varrock seeks experienced gardener to help construct a garden of peace and serenity as surprise for husband.

Only serious Farmers need apply. Peasants welcome (although not that welcome). Tools not supplied.

Please note: under no circumstances are the contents of this message to be disclosed to Rollie – um, one means King Roald.'
Garden of Tranquillity.items:
*Ring of Charos
*All tool leprechaun tools
**A rake
**A seed dibber (or partial completion of the Farming portion of the Barbarian Training miniquest)
**A spade
**Secateurs (magic secateurs work)
**A watering can
**A gardening trowel
*2 plant cures
*A marigold seed (2 recommended in case of failure)
*3+ cabbage seeds (6 recommended to plant in both allotments to increase chance of survival)
*3+ onion seeds (6 recommended to plant in both allotments to increase chance of survival)
*A hammer
*A rune/pure essence
*A pestle and mortar
*A filled plant pot
*2 ultracompost/supercompost/compost (note: Bottomless compost bucket will not work for these two required composts. The quality of these 2 composts do not matter.)

A Tail of Two Cats.start: Talk to Unferth at his house in Burthorpe.
A Tail of Two Cats.description:
Missing: small black cat, answers to the name of Bob.

Last seen on the 19th of Bennath. Please contact Unferth in Burthorpe.
A Tail of Two Cats.items:
*Cat or kitten (hellcats work. Be sure to bring fish for your kitten if you're using one.)
*Catspeak amulet
*5 death runes
*Chocolate cake (made with cake and chocolate bar or chocolate dust with 50 link=Cooking|alt=Cooking )
*Logs (other common types of logs such as willow, maple etc. will work too)
*Tinderbox
*Bucket of milk (or one use of the bottomless milk bucket)
*Shears
*4 potato seeds
*Rake
*Seed dibber (or partial completion of the Farming portion of Barbarian Training)
*Vial of water
*Desert shirt (obtainable during quest) or druid's robe top (the desert outfit does not work)
*Desert robe (obtainable during quest) or druid's robe (the desert outfit does not work)

Wanted!.start: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
Wanted!.description: A wanted man is on the loose. Can you track him down?
Wanted!.items:
*10,000 coins, or:
** Law rune
** Enchanted gem (bought from a Slayer Master)
** Molten glass
*20 un-noted Rune essence or pure essence (you'll get them back)
**File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png The player must deliver all 20 rune essence at once
* Light source (Note: Candles, torches and oil lamps can cause swamp gas explosions if going off-route, and need a tinderbox to stay lit)

Mourning's End Part II.description:
This chapter of the quest takes our hero deep under the mountains of Arandar to put a stop to the evil plans of the mourners.

If our hero is to succeed, they must solve one of the most complicated puzzles in all of Gielinor.
Mourning's End Part II.items:
*Full mourner clothes
*A chisel (one can be found in the house south of the Mourner HQ)
*A death talisman/tiara, catalytic talisman/tiara, Runecraft cape or 50 junk items
*Rope
Mourning's End Part II.enemies: None (but powerful level 73 shadows are aggressive to players inside the temple)

Rum Deal.start: Talk to Pirate Pete on the dock north of Port Phasmatys.
Rum Deal.description: Zombie pirates have arisen on Braindeath Island, and they don't look friendly! Production of 'rum' has stopped, and the pirate brewers are running scared. Can you overcome the horde of drunken, undead pirates? Can you even get to the island without getting a splitting headache?
Rum Deal.items:
*Rake (obtainable during the quest)
*Seed dibber (obtainable during the quest) or partial completion of the Farming portion of the Barbarian Training miniquest
*Bucket (obtainable during the quest)
*At least 47 prayer points for the Evil spirits part of the quest

Shadow of the Storm.start: Talk to Father Reen south of Al Kharid bank.
Shadow of the Storm.description:
A sinister group of dark wizards is attempting to summon Agrith-Naar, a demon of exceptional mystical power. Rather than try to prevent them, a Saradominist priest asks the player to help summon the demon and then kill it once and for all.

But all is not as it seems...
Shadow of the Storm.items:
*Silverlight (obtainable at start of quest)
*Strange implement (obtainable during quest)
*Any black outfit (minimum of 3 pieces, see below for the allowed gear — the dyed Silverlight does not count as a piece of black clothing)
**Note: You can make a black desert robe and shirt during the quest if you brought a desert robe and shirt
*Black dye (from grinding a black mushroom using a pestle and mortar alongside a vial)
*Silver bar
*Means to enter the desert (such as the Shantay pass, Desert amulet 2, Teleport tablets or scrolls, Fairy rings or the Pharaoh's sceptre)
Shadow of the Storm.enemies: Agrith-Naar (level 100, can be flinched with melee)

Making History.start: Talk to Jorral in the outpost north-west of West Ardougne.
Making History.description: A secluded outpost has served the City of Ardougne for generations, playing stage to many exceptional events. Its current occupant wants to employ your skills to construct its true history before time runs out and history itself is wiped away!
Making History.items:
*Spade
*Sapphire amulet
*Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or higher
*A way to enter Port Phasmatys
**Completion of Ghosts Ahoy or
**2 ecto-token or
**1 bone, 1 pot and 1 bucket to earn 5 ecto-tokens (you still only need two) or
**5,200 gold for a Charter ship to Port Phasmatys (cheaper depending upon where you travel from and if you use Ring of Charos(a)).

Ratcatchers.start: Talk to Gertrude west of Varrock.
Ratcatchers.description:
Gertrude knows of some ratcatchers in Varrock, pay her a visit and she may tell you of their whereabouts. Perhaps they could show you and your cat a few pointers about rat catching.

Enter the subterranean world of the rat catchers and discover more of your cat's true potential.
Ratcatchers.items:
*Any type of cat or hellcat (a cat with a high successful rat catch rate is recommended. Overgrown cats are unable to catch rats and cannot be used during the first two sections of the quest, though they may be used during the King rat fight. Any cat with strong combat stats is recommended)
*4 cheese (or 4 Poisoned cheese)
*Rat poison (if cheese is not already poisoned; can be found in the Clock Tower Basement), or made during the quest with the following items:
**Empty vial
**Cleaned kwuarm (grimy will not work; Zahur in Nardah cleans grimy herbs for 200 coins)
**Red spiders' eggs
*Cleaned marrentill (grimy will not work)
*Unicorn horn dust
*Bucket of milk or Bottomless milk bucket
*Catspeak amulet, even if Dragon Slayer II is completed
*Pot of weeds (use an empty pot with weeds)
*Tinderbox
*101 coins (or 51 coins with a Ring of Charos(a))
*Snake charm (obtained from The Feud or during the quest)
*1 free inventory space
Ratcatchers.enemies: None, but your cat will have to fight the King rat

Spirits of the Elid.start: Talk to Awusah the Mayor in Nardah.
Spirits of the Elid.description:
The people in the desert village of Nardah have a problem. Their town well has dried up and any water they try to bring back to the town from the river mysteriously disappears before they can get it back.

The villagers suspect they have been cursed in some way. Can you unravel what is going on and save the village?
Spirits of the Elid.items:
*Runes for Telekinetic Grab (One law and one air rune)
*Needle (Note: a costume needle will not work)
*1-2 thread
*Crush weapon
*Stab weapon
*Slash weapon
*Light source
*Knife (or fletching knife)
*Rope
*Any pickaxe that you have the Mining level to use (a bronze pickaxe can be obtained during the quest)
*Some form of Ranged or Magic attack method, (a shortbow and bronze arrows can be obtained during the quest)

Devious Minds.start: Talk to the monk outside the Paterdomus Temple, at the northern end of the River Salve.
Devious Minds.description: No-one likes to miss a good ceremony, least of all a poor lowly monk who needs your assistance! Will you be able to aid him and make his dreams come true?
Devious Minds.items:
*A mithril 2h sword
*A bow string
*A non-degraded large or colossal pouch
:(You will lose all 3 items!) unless a colossal pouch is used.
Devious Minds.enemies: Abyssal creatures level 41+ (if not using Guardians of the Rift to obtain a large pouch)

The Hand in the Sand.start: Talk to Bert in Yanille, near the sand pit.
The Hand in the Sand.description: Bert the Sandman in Yanille is in a spot of bother. A mysterious severed hand has appeared in his sand box. Help find out whose hand it is and, more to the point, how it got in Bert's sand box.
The Hand in the Sand.items:
*Beer (obtainable during the quest)
*About 150 coins
*1 empty vial
*Redberries (purchasable during the quest from the Food Store in Port Sarim)
*White berries
*Lantern lens
*5 earth runes (can be bought from Betty for 20 gp)
*Bucket of sand (obtainable during quest if you bring a bucket)

Enakhra's Lament.start: Talk to Lazim just north-east of the Desert Quarry.
Enakhra's Lament.description:
Lazim the sculptor has a sad tale to tell - his days of making art are over, and now all he can do is carp at adventurers as they make a statue for him in the desert. Although, isn't just south of the Bandit Camp an odd place to be putting up a statue?
Help Lazim out with his artistic endeavours, and learn more as this quest goes deeper into the history of Gielinor than you might expect...
Enakhra's Lament.items:
*Chisel
*One of the following: bread, any kind of pie, cake or chocolate cake, any kind of pizza, or a baked potato with topping (partial pies, cakes and pizzas do not work, and neither will burnt versions)
*Tinderbox
*Lit candle (a black candle will not work)
*Logs
*Oak logs
*Willow logs
*Maple logs
*Pickaxe (unless you already have the required items)
*Soft clay (obtainable during quest if you bring a pickaxe and bucket, vial or jug of water)
*Coal (obtainable during quest with level link=Mining|alt=Mining 30 Mining [ boostable ] from the quarry)
*52 kg of sandstone (obtainable during quest with level link=Mining|alt=Mining 35 Mining [ boostable ] )
*Two 5 kg pieces of granite (obtainable during quest with level link=Mining|alt=Mining 45 Mining [ boostable ] )
*Runes to cast Fire Bolt, Fire Blast or Fire Wave
*Runes to cast Wind Bolt, Wind Blast or Wind Wave
*Runes to cast Crumble Undead (multiple casts recommended in case of splashing)
*Enough remaining Prayer points to maintain Protect from Melee for about five seconds

Cabin Fever.start: Talk to Bill Teach at The Green Ghost inn in Port Phasmatys.
Cabin Fever.description:
It's war on the high seas as Bill Teach tries to make the journey from Port Phasmatys to the pirate enclave of Mos Le'Harmless!
With his crew heading for the hills, he's looking to recruit anyone eager to become a pirate to help him sink the enemy before he ends up swimming home. He's offering a lot more than a shilling to join his crew. Have you got what it takes to be a pirate?
Cabin Fever.items: You don't need to bring any items yourself. However, make sure that you have at least 11 open inventory spaces for items you will obtain during the quest. A higher amount, like 14 open spaces, is recommended however.

Fairytale I - Growing Pains.start: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener by the pig pen in Draynor Village.
Fairytale I - Growing Pains.description: Recently, farmers around Gielinor have been noticing some trouble with their farming patches. They just don't seem to have the same yields as before. What could be the source of this malady?
Fairytale I - Growing Pains.items:
*Secateurs (obtainable in Sarah's Farming shop north-west of the quest start for 5 coins)
*Spade (obtainable multiple times during quest)
*Ghostspeak amulet
*Dramen staff
*Draynor skull (obtainable during quest)
*A combination of three items picked for you at random, see list of potential items.

Recipe for Disaster.start: Talk to the Cook in the kitchen of Lumbridge Castle.
Recipe for Disaster.description:
The cook in Lumbridge has a surprisingly small number of ingredients on hand in his kitchen, possibly as a result of an endless stream of newcomers with light fingers, taking anything that isn't nailed down from his kitchen.

Luckily, in the past, a kind Cook's Assistant was willing to help him in his culinary duties, but a problem has now appeared that could spell... a Recipe For Disaster!

Almost all members may attempt to solve his tricky predicament, and be rewarded accordingly, but only the
Recipe for Disaster.items:
To start the quest and finish the first chapter:
*Eye of newt
*Greenman's ale
*Rotten tomato
*Any fruit blast excluding a premade fr' blast
*Ashes
To complete all chapters of the quest:
*About 320 coins (or 120 if you have the activated Ring of Charos)
*Bowl of water (an empty bowl can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest)
*Bucket of water (an empty bucket can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest)
*3 buckets of milk (can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest)
*2 eggs (can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest)
*Orange
*Banana (obtainable during the quest)
*Any dye except red, yellow, or orange
*Spice or gnome spice (can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest)
*Gloves (ice gloves are preferred)
*Charcoal
*Fishing bait
*Fishbowl
*2 bread
*Pestle and mortar
*Needle
*3 bronze wires
Recipe for Disaster.enemies:
*Icefiend (level 13) (only if you lack ice gloves)
*5 Mudskippers (level 30/31)
*Crab (level 21/23)
*Evil Chicken (level varies) (see below)
*Black dragon (level 227)
*Big Snake (level 84)
*Zombie monkey (levels 82/129)
*Monkey guard (level 167)
*Ninja monkey (level 86)
*Agrith-Na-Na (Level 146)
*Flambeed (level 149)
*Karamel (level 136)
*Dessourt (level 121)
*Gelatinnoth Mother (level 130)
*Culinaromancer (level 75)

In Aid of the Myreque.start: Talk to to Veliaf Hurtz in the Myreque Hideout below the Canifis pub.
In Aid of the Myreque.description:
After the attack on the Myreque by Vanstrom Klause and with the deaths of both Sani and Harold, Veliaf is counting on you to help. Now that the Myreque freedom fighters' base camp has been revealed, they'll need to move on and set up base somewhere else.

Veliaf has heard of a little known village south of Mort'ton, referred to as 'Burgh de Rott'. This could be just the place to set up operations to strike back against the evil of Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan and his Vampyric overlordship in Mory
In Aid of the Myreque.items:
*A method to damage vampyres, either:
**Efaritay's aid equipped in combination with any weapon OR
**Silver weaponry, which includes:
***Wolfbane dagger
***A blessed or regular silver sickle
***A blessed axe (obtained during Animal Magnetism)
***Silverlight (obtained during Demon Slayer), Darklight (obtained during Shadow of the Storm), Arclight, or Emberlight
*1 piece of any food to enter Burgh de Rott for the first time
*A spade
*1-5 buckets (5 is highly recommended to save time)
*Any pickaxe
*A hammer (Imcando hammer works.)
*11 planks (Only regular planks will work.)
*44 nails (42 are obtainable during the quest)
*Swamp paste
*10 raw mackerel or 10 Snail meats (randomly chosen, but you can manipulate the choice)
*10 bronze axes
*4 tinderboxes
*2 steel bars
*Coal
*Soft clay
*Rope
*A silver bar
*A mithril bar
In Aid of the Myreque.enemies:
*Gadderanks (level 35) (safespottable)
*2 Vampyre Juvinates (level 54) (safespottable)
*2 Vampyre Juvinates (level 75) or 4 level 50s depending on route taken

A Soul's Bane.start: Talk to Launa east of Varrock, just south of the Earth Altar.
A Soul's Bane.description: A rift in the ground has opened up releasing all manner of strange monsters into the lands near the Digsite. A sorrowful mother waits at the top of the rift for her long lost son, who has been missing for 25 years. You can journey down into the rift for an adventure full of twisted monsters all created from the mind of a young boy driven to madness through incarceration.
A Soul's Bane.enemies:
*7-8 angry unicorns, angry bears, angry giant rats, and/or angry goblins
*5 fear reapers (level 42)
*6 confusion beasts (level 43) — must tank them, cannot kill
*5 hopeless creatures (level 40)
*3 parts of Tolna (level 46)

Rag and Bone Man I.start: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea north-east of Varrock, by the Limestone Mine.
Rag and Bone Man I.description: Everybody needs some body, and the Odd Old Man knows exactly which bits of those bodies he needs. Can you help him finish his extensive and extremely creepy collection?
Rag and Bone Man I.items:
*8 coins for 8 pots of vinegar (bring 68 coins if walking to and from Karamja for boat fare)
*8 pots
*8 logs of any type (or an axe to obtain them)
*Tinderbox

Swan Song.start: Talk to Herman Caranos in the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, accessed via a boat trip from the river to the west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Swan Song.description: Out on the edge of the known world, the Piscatoris Fishing Colony stands on the brink of disaster. Angry sea trolls are emerging from the sea and attacking the colonists, preventing them from harvesting the valuable monkfish that live in those waters. A highly experienced adventurer will be needed to drive back the trolls for good. The Colony's director, Herman Caranos, has a particular adventurer in mind: the notoriously amoral Wise Old Man of Draynor Village (allegations of his involvement in
Swan Song.items:
*10 mist runes
*10 lava runes
*5 blood runes
*7 bones (obtainable during the quest)
*An airtight pot – created by using a pot lid on a pot
**Soft clay if making your own pot lid during the quest (2 if also making the pot), or a pickaxe to obtain the clay during the quest
*5 iron bars, or
**a pickaxe (obtainable during the quest) if mining your own iron during quest
*1 set of logs of any kind, or
**an axe (obtainable during quest) if chopping your own logs during quest
*A tinderbox (obtainable during the quest)
*A hammer (obtainable during the quest) or Imcando hammer
*A small fishing net (obtained during the quest)
*A brown apron (obtained during the quest)
