*Arianwyn (level 212)
*Essyllt (level 236)
*Fragment of Seren (level 494)

The Ascent of Arceuus.description: A long time ago, the citizens of Arceuus house gave up their human bodies and claimed immortality. This event was known as the Ascent of Arceuus and it marked the end of death within Arceuus house. Or so they believed. For the first time in a thousand years, a member of Arceuus house has fallen. You will need to solve the mystery of this death. However, time is of the essence and the fate of Arceuus house lies in your hands.

The Forsaken Tower.start: Talk to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj in Lovakengj.
The Forsaken Tower.description: For thousands of years, the Wintertodt has remained safely sealed behind the great Doors of Dinh. Alas, despite the best attempts of the Lovakengj smiths and the Arceuus mages, the doors are failing. Only Dinh himself knew the secrets behind the creation of these doors. Without his knowledge, there may be nothing to stop the Wintertodt escaping and bringing ruin upon Kourend. It is up to you to recover this knowledge.

The Fremennik Exiles.start: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka.
The Fremennik Exiles.description: The Fremennik bards often sing tales of the past. Of great battles, deadly foes and heroes long gone. However, in recent years, things have been much quieter in the Province, as there's increasingly less to sing about. All that is about to change though, as what starts off as a simple investigation soon leads to one of the greatest threats the Fremennik have ever seen.
The Fremennik Exiles.items:
*Combat equipment
*Mirror shield
*2 Kegs of beer (cannot be obtained in Rellekka during quest, buy from Thora the Barkeep before starting the quest)
*1 Molten glass
*100 Astral runes
*Pet rock
*Fishing rod, fly fishing rod, or barbarian fishing rod
*Fremennik shield (this is not the tradeable Neitiznot shield)
**Alternatively, get it from Bardur AFTER being exiled, for either 150,000 or for free using a Ring of Charos(a)
**Recommended: Rune thrownaxes or link=Agility|alt=Agility 85 Agility to get to Bardur in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon
*Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i)
*Hammer
*Glassblowing pipe
*3 Lunar bars
**Or a pickaxe to obtain 3 ores to turn into Lunar bars (requires link=Mining|alt=Mining 60 Mining [ boostable ] ).
*Seal of Passage (if the elite Fremennik diaries aren't completed)

X Marks the Spot.start: Talk to Veos in The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge.
X Marks the Spot.description: Veos has long been a lover of treasure hunts and his latest hunt has brought him to Lumbridge. However, not knowing the area well, Veos could use some help finding this treasure.
X Marks the Spot.items: * Spade (the Eastfloor spade does not work)

The Curse of Arrav.start: Talk to Elias White at the Uzer Oasis.
The Curse of Arrav.description: The icy waste to the north of the troll country is as mysterious as any land in Gielinor, no less because of the interest the Mahjarrat take in it. Elias White thinks that he might have found a way for you to discover more about this strange area to the north. Uncover more of the mysteries of the Mahjarrat and learn about the dark magic that was used to enslave Arrav for these last few millennia.
The Curse of Arrav.items:
*3 dwellberries
*Ring of life
*Any pickaxe
*Any crossbow (except the love crossbow)
*Mith grapple (Hallowed grapple will not work)
*Insulated boots

Defender of Varrock.start: Talk to Elias White in the Jolly Boar Inn.
Defender of Varrock.description: Long ago, one man wielding a magic shield stood against the undead armies of the Mahjarrat. His name was Arrav, and he was strong and noble, but the fates had spoken: his downfall at the hands of the evil necromancer Zemouregal was inevitable. In one last desperate act to save his people, Arrav flung the shield towards the town now known as Varrock, protecting it from further harm. In that very moment, Zemouregal struck him down. Standing over the fatally wounded hero, Zemouregal made a promise:
Defender of Varrock.items:
* Chaos core (obtainable during the quest)
*Barronite deposit or a pickaxe to mine one
Defender of Varrock.enemies:
* At least six armoured zombies (level 85)
* Multiple Chaos Golems (level 70)

In Search of Knowledge.start: Brother Aimeri, towards the south-eastern end of the Forthos Dungeon.
In Search of Knowledge.description: Assist Brother Aimeri in uncovering the mysteries that lie in the Forthos Dungeon.
In Search of Knowledge.items:
* Combat equipment
* 5 pieces of food (must be meat, fish or vegetables)
* A slash weapon or knife to cut through webs

Sins of the Father.start: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz outside the church in Slepe.
Sins of the Father.description: A darkness has fallen over Morytania. The Myreque freedom fighters have achieved their first major victory over the vampyres with the death of Ranis Drakan. However, their newly found hope is unlikely to last. After many years of absence, Lord Lowerniel Drakan, the vampyre overlord of Morytania, has finally emerged from his castle. He has but one goal. To avenge his brother and eradicate the Myreque once and for all.
Sins of the Father.items:
*Any axe
*Vyrewatch outfit (top, legs, and shoes) or 1,950 coins to purchase it from Trader Sven's Black-market Goods (can be obtained during quest)
*Ivandis flail
*Ruby
*Knife (can be obtained during quest)
*Chisel
*Runes for Lvl-3 Enchant (1 cosmic rune, 5 fire runes) or an enchant ruby or topaz tablet
Sins of the Father.enemies:
*Kroy (level 133)
*Nail beast (level 143 & 67 twice)
*Vampyre Juvinate (level 119) twice
*Mutated Bloodveld (level 123)
*Damien Leucurte (level 204)
*Vanstrom Klause (level 459)

A Kingdom Divided.start: Talk to Martin Holt at the entrance to Kourend Castle in Kingstown.
A Kingdom Divided.description:
Great Kourend: a land of wealth, comfort and security. Across its five cities, the people of this Kingdom work to bring peace and prosperity. However, all is not as it seems. Beneath this delicate façade lies an uncomfortable truth: the kingdom of Great Kourend is A Kingdom Divided.

Since the death of the last king, Great Kourend has been ruled by the Kourend Council. Under the watchful gaze of the Council, Kourend has enjoyed a golden age of progression. But not all of its citizens are happy,
A Kingdom Divided.items:
* Normal spellbook, and runes to cast a fire spell (fire bolt or better)
* Any axe
* A defence potion (3 or 4 doses)
* Volcanic sulphur
* Molten glass
* A dark essence block or a pickaxe and chisel (the latter is found at the mine) to obtain one
A Kingdom Divided.enemies:
* Judge of Yama (Level 168)
* 2 Assassins (Level 132)
* Lizardman brute (Level 75)
* Xamphur (level 239)
* Barbarian Warlord (Level 91)

Daddy's Home.start: Speak to Marlo in the Estate Agent's house in north-east Varrock.
Daddy's Home.description: Marlo's father requires someone to refurnish his disastrous house.
Daddy's Home.items:
*10 planks – (oak/teak/mahogany will not work)
*5 bolts of cloth (can be bought from the Sawmill for 650 coins per bolt)
*At least 16 nails of any type, e.g. steel nails (more are recommended as nails bend when building furniture. 100 is recommended at 1 Construction, obtainable from the Sawmill during the quest)
*Hammer (Obtainable during the quest from Yarlo)
*Saw (Obtainable during the quest)

A Porcine of Interest.start: Read the town notice board in Draynor Village, behind Fortunato's Wine Shop.
A Porcine of Interest.description:
Ah, the Falador Farm - filled with cabbages, cows, and even a sleepy sheepdog. A peaceful place, where you can learn to churn butter, give a dog a bone, or purchase various Farming supplies. What was once a place of happiness, joy and wholesome dairy goods has of late become dominated by a vile presence. Each morning Sarah wakes to find her crops destroyed, her cows cowering, and her loyal sheepdog looking... sheepish. 
She's had enough, but she thinks she's got the culprit on the trot. Can you
A Porcine of Interest.items:
* Rope
* Knife or a slash weapon (except abyssal whip, abyssal tentacle, noxious halberd, or dragon claws) (obtainable during the quest)

Getting Ahead.start: Talk to Gordon on his farm south of the Farming Guild.
Getting Ahead.description: Gordon and Mary are two small-town farmers with a big problem – some heinous beastie keeps taking their livestock! Luckily they've hit upon a solution. They just need some brave adventurer to venture into the creature's lair and bring them back its head. We can't envisage any complications with such a routine matter, right?
Getting Ahead.items:
*Bear fur, grey wolf fur, or Fur (a Grizzly bear and bear cub spawn west of the farm and two black bears spawn east of the farm)
*Soft clay or a pickaxe you can use
** Clay rocks are found in the Kebos Lowlands mine passed during the quest;
** Gordon's house has a water source and a bucket spawn;
** There is a Bronze pickaxe spawn at the mine, stuck in some rocks.
*Hammer (obtainable near the cattle gate) or Imcando hammer
*Saw (obtainable in the shed north of the house) or Amy's saw
*2 normal planks (obtainable near the cave entrance)
*At least 6 nails of any kind (iron nails can be found in the workbench north of the house, and more than 6 is recommended in case you bend a few)
*Knife (obtainable on the kitchen table in the house)
*Red dye (obtainable from the shelves in the house)
*Pot of flour (obtainable upstairs in the house)
*Needle (obtainable upstairs in the house) or Costume needle
*Thread (obtainable upstairs in the house) unless you're using the Costume needle

Below Ice Mountain.start: Talk to Willow on the path south of Ice Mountain.
Below Ice Mountain.description: Willow, an energetic archaeologist (perhaps suspiciously so) is hunting for her next big discovery. She believes she has found the entrance to ancient underground ruins found to the west of Ice Mountain. There's a catch though - the entrance is sealed tight and she needs to re-unite her old crew to help her break in. Naturally, she has to stay close to the ruins in order to lay claim to the find, so it falls to you to bring her rag-tag group back together for one last caper and a final big pay-o
Below Ice Mountain.items:
* Cooked meat (obtainable during the quest)
* Bread
* Knife
* Beer (obtainable during the quest)
** Alternatively Asgarnian ale, Dwarven stout, or a Wizard's mind bomb
Below Ice Mountain.enemies: Ancient Guardian (level 25) (optional with a pickaxe and link=Mining|alt=Mining 10 Mining [ boostable ] )

A Night at the Theatre.start: Talk to the Mysterious Stranger inside Ver Sinhaza, south-east of Meiyerditch.
A Night at the Theatre.description: The Mysterious Stranger lurks outside of the mighty Theatre of Blood, the centrepiece of Ver Sinhaza. This shadowy figure has a new request for you – to humiliate a vampyre noble by the name of Lady Verzik Vitur. Take on the challenges that lie within the Theatre to reach her and bring a blush to her bloodless face!
A Night at the Theatre.items:
*Ivandis flail or Blisterwood flail
*Saw (crystal saw also works)
*Ghostspeak amulet (Morytania legs 2 or better also work)
*Any axe besides the blessed axe
A Night at the Theatre.enemies:
*Vyrewatch (Level 105)
*Several venomous araxyte (Levels 96 and 146) (can be avoided)
*Hespori (Level 302)
*All Theatre of Blood bosses (optional, if a kill count has been acquired before starting the quest):
**The Maiden of Sugadinti and Nylocas Matomenos
**Pestilent Bloat
**Nylocas Toxobolos, Nylocas Hagios, Nylocas Ischyros and Nylocas Vasilias
**Sotetseg
**Xarpus
**Verzik Vitur, Nylocas Athanatos and Nylocas Matamenos

Beneath Cursed Sands.start: Talk to Jamila at her stall in Sophanem.
Beneath Cursed Sands.description: When Sophanem was beset by a series of plagues, the gates to the golden city of Menaphos quickly closed. The city has been locked down ever since, with no one allowed to leave or enter. However, rumours have escaped of strange happenings inside Menaphos and there are stories of citizens mysteriously disappearing. These odd happenings need to be investigated, but few are willing to do so. Maisa, a spy from Al Kharid, has grown tired of inaction. She is determined to solve this mystery herself, bu
Beneath Cursed Sands.items:
* Coal
* Iron bar
* Tinderbox (obtainable during quest)
* Spade (obtainable during quest)
* Any cooked or raw meat (purchasable from shop during quest. The following meats will NOT work: fish, raw bird meat, raw yak meat, raw pyre fox, raw chompy, and raw t-bone steak)
Beneath Cursed Sands.enemies:
* Head Menaphite Guard (level 174) without the use of protection prayers
* Two Scarab Mages (level 119)
* The Champion of Scabaras (level 379)
* Menaphite Akh (level 351)

The Frozen Door.start: Receive an important letter from a messenger.
The Frozen Door.description: A messenger has an important letter for you. Apparently, a great treasure lies with the God Wars Dungeon beneath Trollheim. Defeat the leaders of each of the four armies and claim your prize behind the frozen door...
The Frozen Door.items:
* Mith grapple
* A crossbow
* 2 ropes to reach Saradomin's Encampment; one-time only
* A hammer or dragon warhammer
The Frozen Door.enemies:
* Kree'arra (level 580)
* General Graardor (level 624)
* Commander Zilyana (level 596)
* K'ril Tsutsaroth (level 650)
Alternatives:
*Flight Kilisa (level 159)
*Wingman Skree (level 143)
*Flockleader Geerin (level 149)
*Sergeant Strongstack (level 141)
*Sergeant Steelwill (level 142)
*Sergeant Grimspike (level 142)
*Bree (level 146)
*Starlight (level 149)
*Growler (level 139)
*Tstanon Karlak (level 145)
*Zakl'n Gritch (level 142)
*Balfrug Kreeyath (level 151)

Hopespear's Will.start: Speak to Hopespear in the crypt of the Goblin Temple.
Hopespear's Will.description: Help an old goblin spirit return the remains of his successors to the lost goblin homeland.
Hopespear's Will.items:
* Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better
* Ring of visibility or ring of shadows
* Goblin potion
* Dramen or lunar staff (unless the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary has been fully completed)
* Food and potions to defeat 5 enemies without armour, weapons, or magic

Temple of the Eye.start: Talk to Wizard Persten north of Al Kharid, near the gate from Lumbridge.
Temple of the Eye.description: The Abyss: a deadly realm filled with ancient power. The secrets of this plane have long eluded the denizens of the Wizards' Tower, though some would give anything to properly uncover them. One of these wizards is Persten. While many in the Tower aren't convinced by her unorthodox methods, a recent discovery means she may now hold the key to the knowledge they crave the most. However, nothing is simple when the Abyss is involved, and Persten won't be able to get to the bottom of her discovery wi
Temple of the Eye.items:
* Bucket of water
* Chisel (obtainable during quest)
* Pickaxe (obtainable during quest)

The Path of Glouphrie.start: Speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village.
The Path of Glouphrie.description: King Bolren has a new pet. Unfortunately, it's another watcher, like the ones unmasked in the Tree Gnome Stronghold during The Eyes of Glouphrie. Has Glouphrie been watching the Tree Gnome Village, too? If you investigate further you'll find out more about Glouphrie, the history of the gnomes (and their unusual monarchy) and maybe you'll get within a hair's breadth of the lost city of Arposandra...
The Path of Glouphrie.items:
* Tree Gnome Village Dungeon key (unless Roving Elves has been started) (obtainable during the quest)
* Combat equipment and some food
* Mith Grapple
* Any crossbow

Sleeping Giants.start: Talk to Kovac at the Giants' Plateau, east of Al Kharid.
Sleeping Giants.description:
Ahh, giants. We all know them. Enormous humanoids hanging about Gielinor, simply minding their own business until some adventurer or another comes along to beat them up.

But how much do we really know about these giants? What do they think about? Where did they come from? Would they enjoy making massive swords in some kind of... gargantuan workshop?

All these questions, and more, will be answered in the quest Sleeping Giants! You'll help Kovac, a friendly giant who's discovered an ancient forg
Sleeping Giants.items:
* 3 oak logs
* 1 wool (ball of wool will not work)
* 10 nails
* Hammer or Imcando hammer (Other types of hammers will not work)
* Chisel
* 1 bucket of water (Obtainable during quest) or ice gloves

Into the Tombs.start: Talk to Maisa inside Osmumten's tomb at the Necropolis.
Into the Tombs.description:
Long ago, the people of the Kharidian Desert lived prosperous, luxurious lives, under the watchful eyes of their beloved gods.

All that changed when Amascut, the Goddess of Rebirth, became corrupted. She was reborn as The Devourer, intent on consuming every living soul in existence.

Deep within the desert, an ancient tomb has long hidden a great power – and The Devourer is determined to harness it at any cost.

If she succeeds, all hope is lost. You must traverse the tomb's many obstacles and
Into the Tombs.enemies:
* Note: This section assumes the raid level is 0 (no invocations).
* Akkha (level 337)
* Ba-Ba (level 359)
* Kephri (level 341)
* Zebak (level 371)
* Tumeken's Warden (level 489)
* Elidinis' Warden (level 489)

The Garden of Death.start: Search the tent at the campsite found east of the chasm at the southern end of the Kebos Lowlands.
The Garden of Death.description:
In our newest Twisted Tale, you’ll piece together a long-lost language and unravel the mystery of some ancient ruins. Welcome, adventurer, to The Garden of Death.

This quest contains no dialogue and focuses solely on environmental storytelling, so make sure that you set aside some time and prepare to be fully immersed in the world around you!
The Garden of Death.items: * Secateurs (obtainable during quest) (magic secateurs also work)

Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.start: Investigate the Ancient Vault north-east of Nardah.
Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.description:
During Gielinor's Second Age, the world was dominated by an empire the likes of which had never been seen. The areas now known as Asgarnia, Misthalin and even the Wilderness all once flourished under the banner of the Empty Lord. With the grand city of Senntisten at its heart, this civilisation washed over Gielinor like an unstoppable tide, pushing the boundaries of magic and science, while crushing any who stood in their way.

Fast forward to today, the Fifth Age, and you won't find much trace
Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.items:
* Be on the Ancient Magicks spellbook
* Runes to cast Blood Burst, Ice Burst, Smoke Burst, and Shadow Burst
**8 Death runes
**16 Chaos runes
**2 Fire runes
**3 Air runes
**4 Water runes
**2 Soul runes
**2 Blood runes
* Ring of visibility
* Tinderbox (obtainable during the quest)
* Pestle and mortar (obtainable during the quest)
* Pickaxe (obtainable during the quest)
* Facemask or Slayer helm
Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.enemies:
* Ancient Guardian (level 153)
* Vardorvis (level 572)
* Kasonde (level 193)
* A number of lesser demons, black demons, and abyssal creatures
* The Leviathan (level 593)
* Jhallan (level 491)
* Duke Sucellus (level 538)
* The Whisperer (level 587)
* Mysterious Figure (level 271)
* The Forsaken Assassin (level 252)
* Ketla the Unworthy (level 236)
* Kasonde the Craven (level 221)
* Persten the Deceitful (level 264)

Secrets of the North.start: Talk to the guard outside of the Carnillean Mansion in the south-western corner of East Ardougne.
Secrets of the North.description: Our story begins - as all good murder mysteries do - with a mysterious murder, and there's no shortage of suspects - in fact, you're one of them! Be prepared to form an uneasy alliance, dig up secrets best left buried deep, and walk away with more questions than answers...
Secrets of the North.items:
*100 Coins
*Lockpick (Strange Old Lockpick does NOT work)
*Tinderbox (obtainable during the quest)

His Faithful Servants.start: Speak to the Strange Old Man wandering in the Barrows, east of Mort'ton.
His Faithful Servants.description: The Strange Old Man at the Barrows in Morytania has been acting even stranger than usual...
His Faithful Servants.items:
* Combat equipment to defeat the Barrows Brothers
* Spade
His Faithful Servants.enemies:
* Verac the Defiled (level 115)
* Dharok the Wretched (level 115)
* Ahrim the Blighted (level 98)
* Torag the Corrupted (level 115)
* Karil the Tainted (level 98)
* Guthan the Infested (level 115)

Children of the Sun.start: Talk to Noah or Alina in Varrock square.
Children of the Sun.description: Children of the Sun begins on the familiar streets of Varrock, where a delegation from Varlamore has arrived to sign a treaty with the rulers of Misthalin. It’s a day for celebration, but something’s amiss… you’d better find out what’s going on!

Perilous Moons.start: Talk to Zuma or Attala at the entrance to Cam Torum.
Perilous Moons.description: Beneath the steep and jagged cliffs of Ralos' Rise sits the dwarven town of Cam Torum. Its strong fortifications have kept it safe through all of Varlamore's history... but now the inhabitants face a new challenge. Lurking below the surface is an ancient temple, built to contain powerful entities. Now, the earth has been disturbed – and the dwarves need your help to keep these strange beings contained!
Perilous Moons.items:
* Knife (obtainable during quest)
* Big fishing net (obtainable during quest)
* Rope (obtainable during quest)
* Pestle and mortar (obtainable during quest)
* Combat equipment for multiple PvM encounters.
Perilous Moons.enemies:
* Sulphur Nagua (level 98)
* Blue Moon (level 329)
* Blood Moon (level 329)
* Eclipse Moon (level 329)

The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour.start: Talk to Marcellus at the Locus Oasis.
The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour.description: Solve a ribbiting dispute and gain access to a new hardwood Farming patch.
The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour.items: * Any axe (a bronze axe is obtainable during the quest)

Twilight's Promise.start: Talk to Ennius Tullus or Furia Tullus in front of the Sunrise Palace.
Twilight's Promise.description: Take your first steps into Varlamore and unlock the Quetzal Transport System.
Twilight's Promise.items: * Items for two different combat classes or a poisoned weapon (be warned that the poison method is much slower).

At First Light.start: Talk to Guildmaster Apatura at the Hunter Guild.
At First Light.description: Learn about the role of the Hunter Guild and unlock higher tier rumours.
At First Light.items:
* Needle or costume needle (one needle spawns in Pellem's Fur Store nearby)
* Hammer (obtainable during quest) or Imcando hammer
* 2 jerboa tails (obtainable during quest)
** or a Box trap (can be bought from Imia's Supplies nearby)

The Heart of Darkness.start: Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat.
The Heart of Darkness.description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious cult and unlock a new dungeon.
The Heart of Darkness.items:
* 30 coins
* Pickaxe (obtainable during quest)
* Up to 4 empty inventory slots
The Heart of Darkness.enemies:
* Several Emissary Brawlers (levels 74 and 86)
* Several Emissary Conjurers (level 71)
* Prince Itzla Arkan (level 167)
* Amoxliatl (level 263)

Death on the Isle.start: Talk to Patzi by the entrance to Villa Lucens.
Death on the Isle.description: Solve a mysterious murder on the island of Aldarin.
Death on the Isle.enemies: Two low-level enemies must be fought with no equipment, but you can’t die to them

Meat and Greet.start: Talk to Emelio at his home in Outer Fortis.
Meat and Greet.description: Bring the joy of kebabs to the land of Varlamore.

Ethically Acquired Antiquities.start: Inspect the empty display on the ground floor of the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis.
Ethically Acquired Antiquities.description: Investigate a mysterious theft from the Fortis Grand Museum.

The Blood Moon Rises.start: Talk to Sarius Guile in the Icyene Graveyard.
The Blood Moon Rises.description:
Long ago, before the vampyres were united as one, they lived in disparate clans in their ancestral home of Vampyrium. For the Drakan clan, strength ruled above all else. Clan leaders were selected during a brutal festival of combat known as the Night of the Blood Moon. Along with leadership of the clan, the victor of this festival was granted a title: they became known as the Blood Moon.

Now, thousands of years later, Lord Lowerniel Drakan, the last Blood Moon has returned. He has but one goal:
The Blood Moon Rises.items:
* Blisterwood flail or 40,000 coins
* Vyre noble clothing (obtainable for free during quest from the chest in the Myreque Hideout under Old Man Ral's house)
* Melee combat gear
* Tinderbox (obtainable during quest)
* Pickaxe (a bronze pickaxe is obtainable during quest from Ivan Strom)
* Hammer (obtainable during quest)
* Knife (obtainable during quest)
* Chisel (obtainable during quest)
* Blisterwood logs (obtainable during quest)
The Blood Moon Rises.enemies:
* Several vyrewatch and vyrewatch sentinels during various encounters
* Several Monk of Zamorak (level 36)
* Several level 106 Sanguidae
* Several level 98 Webbed-winged Crows
* A level 195 Venator (as well as a few more optional ones)
* Four Ancient feral vyres
* Several waves of Nylocas
* The Maiden of Sugadinti
* Nylocas Vasilias
* Wyrd (level 564)
* Lowerniel Drakan (level 1063) (four total fights)

The Final Dawn.start: Talk to Servius in the Sunrise Palace.
The Final Dawn.description: Bring an end to the plots of a deadly cult and unlock a new boss.
The Final Dawn.items:
* Emissary robes
*Any kind of bones (except sun-kissed bones) or raw meat/cooked meat
*A knife (obtainable during the quest)
*A beer (obtainable during the quest)
The Final Dawn.enemies:
* Emissary Enforcer (lvl-196)
* Chimalli (lvl-160) and Lucius (lvl-160)
* Multiple waves of Emissary cultists (lvl-70 to lvl-90)
* Ennius Tullus (lvl-306)
* Augur Metzli (lvl-396)

Pandemonium.start: Talk to Will and Anne on the docks of Port Sarim.
Pandemonium.description: Embark on your first voyage and unlock the Sailing skill.
Pandemonium.items:
* Hammer (obtainable during the quest)
* Saw (obtainable during the quest)

Prying Times.start: Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie at The Pandemonium pub.
Prying Times.description: Help Steve Beanie recover some 'pirate treasure' and unlock the crowbar, a useful Sailing tool.
Prying Times.items:
* Hammer or Imcando hammer (obtainable during quest)
* Steel bar
* Redberry pie
* Captain's log

Current Affairs.start: Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks.
Current Affairs.description: Help Arhein get past some political red tape and unlock the current duck, a useful Sailing tool.

Troubled Tortugans.start: Talk to the injured tortugan on a Remote Island in the Unquiet Ocean.
Troubled Tortugans.description: Help a stranded tortugan and gain access to the Great Conch.
Troubled Tortugans.items:
* Any axe (a bronze axe can be found during the quest, but bringing a better one is recommended for cutting 10 logs)
* Hammer (obtainable during the quest) or Imcando hammer
* Saw (obtainable during the quest) or Amy's saw

The Red Reef.start: Talk to Elder Raley at his home on the Great Conch.
The Red Reef.description: Investigate the dealings of the Red Reef Trading Company and gain access to some trees to cut.
The Red Reef.items:
* A boat
* Cannons on your boat for ship combat, or Magic/Ranged gear to skip it
The Red Reef.enemies:
* 2 pirate ships (or the crew on the ship)
** Oaky Doak (level 77)
** Boatswain Bill Teak (level 77)
** Mister U. (level 77)
** Captain Ruban Acer (level 95)
** Old Jack (level 77)
** Mute Jack (level 77)
** Bloody Jack (level 77)
** Captain Jack (level 95)
* 6 pirates (level 52)
* Black Eye Bethel (level 191)
* Giant lobster (level 112, safespottable)

Shadows of Custodia.start: Read the notice board in Auburn Pub.
Shadows of Custodia.description: Solve the case of some missing people and unlock a new dungeon.
Shadows of Custodia.items:
*4 willow longbows
**Can be purchased from Arcuani's Archery Supplies in Tal Teklan or Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock
*4 maple logs (obtainable during quest)
*Fishing rod (obtainable during quest) (Oily fishing rod, Pearl fishing rod, or Barbarian rod also works)
*Hammer (obtainable during quest)

Scrambled!.start: Talk to Alan at the temple of Tal Teok north of Tal Teklan.
Scrambled!.items:
All items obtainable during quest:
* Bowl of water (two spawn in town, fountain next to bank)
* 2 planks (south of the town near the water)
* 6 nails (more recommended as they can bend, 20 nails may be found on the workbench)
* Saw (spawn in range shop) or Amy's saw
* Hammer (spawn in furnace house) or Imcando hammer
Scrambled!.enemies:
* Large chicken (level 16) - can be recoiled
* Black jaguar (level 88) - can be safespotted or recoiled
* Red dragon (level 106) - can be safespotted or recoiled

Vale Totems (miniquest).description: Vale Totems is a miniquest accompanying the Vale Totems minigame.
Vale Totems (miniquest).items:
* Oak logs or better (obtainable during the quest with an axe)
* Knife (obtainable during the quest)
* Four fletched items of the same type of wood as the logs, such as unstrung longbows or shields (obtainable during the quest)

Spirit of Adventure.start: Speak to the ghost in Auburn Valley while wearing a ghostspeak amulet.
Spirit of Adventure.description: The ghost of Bernina wishes to move on but has unfinished business.
Spirit of Adventure.items:
* Ghostspeak amulet
* Logs (obtainable during quest)
* Tinderbox (obtainable during quest)

Lost Lover.start: Speak to either Fabia or Xilo in the Tlati Rainforest
Lost Lover.description: Reunite Fabia and Xilo by solving their miscommunication.

Learning the Ropes.start: Talk to the Quest Guide on Tutorial Island.

The Ides of Milk.start: Talk to Cassius by the Lumbridge pond.
The Ides of Milk.description: Lumbridge, the iconic city for all the fresh-faced arrivals and budding adventurers. Home to regular citizens of Gielinor, they chop the trees, work the fields, and tend to the animals of the realm, except there has been a disturbance in the nearby cow pen and the steaks have never been higher! Distress runs through the herd and while they have always feared adventurers claiming their lives, a new threat has entered their domain bringing the beef...

Fallen From Grace.start: Talk to Cormac, the mayor of Auchrie, on the island of Wyrmscraig.
Fallen From Grace.description: Help the citizens of an isolated island and unlock new training methods and a repeatable boss.
Fallen From Grace.items:
* A raft or skiff (a sloop does NOT work) (You MUST use your own boat - you will not be able to disembark in Wyrmscraig Cavern unless you are the only player on the boat)
* A pickaxe (obtainable during the quest)
* A chisel (obtainable during the quest)
* Combat equipment and supplies to defeat the Mad Angel, weak to Crush

A Ruff Situation.start: Talk to Talia in the Dog Shelter just south-west of the Edgeville Monastery.
A Ruff Situation.description: Help Talia and Chase set up their dog shelter and unlock your very own canine companion.
A Ruff Situation.items:
* Either a needle or a costume needle
* Thread. Not required if using costume needle.
* Fur, you can use; Fur, bear fur, grey wolf fur, fox fur, or jaguar fur. Some fur's can be purchased from Baraek for 20 coins in Varrock Square (Fur, Bear Fur, Grey Wolf Fur).
* Grain. Can be picked from the nearby wheat field north of the Cooks' Guild.

Crab Quest.start: Sail to Dognose Island (north-west of the Great Conch) and drink from the strange bottle to start the quest.
Crab Quest.description: After feeling strangely compelled to drink a mysterious bottle on a beach, you help a crab organise a traditional ceremony and find a mate by gathering instruments, building sand nests, and convincing other crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

Fairytale III - Nexus of Power.description:
The Fairy Godfather is scheming, gathering his minions in a bid to snatch the powerful artifact used by the fairies to establish the Fairy ring network; the Nexus. With the power of teleportation at his fingertips, what will be left to stop him and an army of orcs from expanding their dominion and raiding all of Gielinor?

That would be you.

You'll need to assemble a crack team of experts, made up of old friends and new, ready to take on a heist for the ages and steal the Nexus before the Fairy
